[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · **English** # agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve KV-cache hits · Keep cache warm automatically · Protect context quota · Rescue crashed sessions** No extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in Sidecar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [![Clones](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive/main/badges/Antigravity-agy-dart.json)](https://github.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive) [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin stabilizes controllable client-side prefixes and reduces repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how the host constructs requests and on backend caching behavior (if you use a dynamic proxy pool, pinning a single exit node can serve as a controlled troubleshooting experiment). Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. 9. **Works smoothly alongside your Skills, plus a Skills bloat check**: Use it with any Skills in Antigravity, Claude Code, or Codex — your Skills guide the workflow while `agy-dart` quietly blocks giant file reads, trims noisy logs, and looks after your cache; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to see how much startup context each installed Skill uses and spot oversized main files. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.8/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.8/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.8 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.8 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache warming is off by default. To turn it on for a chat, enable **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel — or click **Warm 1×** next to the countdown anytime for a single manual ping. **Global Warm** sets the default count and timing (**Auto**, **Fixed 4 / 9 / 15 min**, or **Custom 1–60 min**) for chats that haven't picked their own. Turning warming off for a chat silences its expiry and limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled chats are also off by default and can be enabled separately. Each warm-up asks the model for a short `OK` reply and uses input tokens (or the full conversation if the cache already expired). The panel also controls desktop alerts, pausing protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` > **Troubleshooting (`ide-tools` duplicate `/required` error):** If Antigravity fails during toolbox initialization with `building toolbox: tool "mcp_ide-tools_mcp_agy-dart_fast_apply_edits" advertises an invalid parameter schema ... at '/required': items at 1 and 2 are equal`, the host's `ide-tools` bridge is re-wrapping already-eager `mcp_agy-dart_fast_*` tools and appending `toolSummary` to `/required` a second time without deduplicating (`agy-dart` itself only declares `"required": ["edits"]`). Switch to lazy loading and restart Antigravity: > > ```bash > node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy > ``` > > (Or remove `"tools"` / `"eager": true` under `mcpServers.fast` in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/mcp_config.json` and restart. See [skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md](skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md) for diagnostics.) --- ## Changelog ### v1.7.8 - **Opt-in silent auto-updates (default OFF)**: Added an `Auto-Update: OFF/ON` toggle in the dashboard topbar (also configurable via `autoUpdateInstall` in `~/.agy-dart/config.json` or `AGY_DART_AUTO_UPDATE_INSTALL` / `AGY_DART_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE_INSTALL`). When enabled, background checks (at startup and every 6 hours) silently upgrade same-major releases only when a verified SHA-256 `.tgz` asset is present, defer during active TTL keepalive pings, trip a per-version circuit breaker on failure, and display a one-time dismissible notice after reload. ### v1.7.7 - **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) native support (`--target dsh`)**: Added a zero-dependency native Cordis plugin (`dsh/plugin.mjs`) and `--target dsh` installer (`--profile ` / `--mcp-only`) that mounts both MCP servers (`agy_dart_fast` & `agy_dart_context` with tuned `toolCallTimeoutMs`), bridges DSH native `tools/pre-execute` / `tools/execute` / `tools/result` (supporting `read`, Windows `pwsh`, `bash`, `edit`, `write`, `apply_patch`), syncs `~/.dsh/skills/agy-dart/`, and adds `node bin/agy-dart.mjs dashboard` to open the live dashboard standalone. Zero token or behavior overhead on Antigravity. - **Archived-conversation keepalive guard**: Automatically suppresses background auto-keepalive pings, manual warm-ups, and desktop alerts for archived conversations without losing state, and cleanly resumes when unarchived. ### v1.7.6 - **One-click self-update & startup version check in the panel** (thanks to [@bestmulicc](https://github.com/bestmulicc), [#5](https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/pull/5)): The right-sidebar panel now checks GitHub Releases for new versions on startup (disable via `autoUpdateCheck: false` in `~/.agy-dart/config.json` or `AGY_DART_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`) and lets you click **Check Update** / **Update Now** to upgrade in place without running terminal commands. - **Verified downloads, automatic rollback & preserved settings**: Prefers the release `.tgz` package with SHA-256 verification before unpacking, rolls back automatically if a file is locked, reloads the panel cleanly, and keeps your local `rules/*.local.md`, tool-loading mode, `--with-devtools` tools, and synced Gemini/T3 copies intact. ### v1.7.5 - **One-click manual `Warm 1×` button in the panel**: Added a manual warm-up button right next to the cache countdown. It works even when Auto-Keepalive is off and doesn't use up your automatic warm-up limit (with double-click protection and rollback if sending fails). - **Skip hopeless last-second warm-ups & unified countdown**: When only a few seconds are left and a warm-up ping won't arrive in time, the plugin skips it to avoid wasting tokens and falls back to a desktop alert instead. The panel, background monitor, and alerts now all share the same expiry countdown, and warming stops right away if the cache has already expired. ### v1.7.4 - **Warmer wording for "Copy Handoff Prompt"**: Updated the handoff prompt templates with a friendlier opening (`宝宝，` in Chinese / `Sweetie,` in English) and asked the AI to start its generated handoff summary the same way — still body-only, with no filler. ### v1.7.3 - **Custom Auto-Keepalive intervals**: Pick **Auto**, **Fixed 4 / 9 / 15 min**, or **Custom (1–60 min)** globally or per chat, with one-click reset back to **Global**. All existing safety guards (max count, skipping short chats, stopping after a cache miss, and skipping background subagents) stay on. - **Fixed false warnings on timeouts and partial test runs**: Timed-out commands no longer trigger "repeated edit-fail" alerts; passing an unrelated test or a single test case won't erase an earlier full-suite failure; background test errors stay visible even after editing other files; and if a failing check log gets cut off, the panel keeps flagging it until you re-run it. - **Cleaner handoff summaries & clearer cache-miss reasons**: Copy cleaner progress summaries before switching chats or compacting (with secrets auto-masked), and see more accurate reasons when the cache misses. ### v1.7.2 - **Lighter built-in skill docs & a Skills bloat check**: Moved sample scripts and troubleshooting notes into on-demand files so they don't eat startup context when unused; added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to check how much startup context each installed Skill uses and spot oversized main files. - **Leaner output from built-in helper agents**: The built-in coding (`dart-coder`) and review (`dart-reviewer`) subagents stay lightweight without carrying extra external tools or global rules, and now route quick checks through output trimming instead of dumping long terminal logs into the chat. ### v1.7.1 - **Fixed the panel's "Blocked Noise" counter staying at 0**: Bytes saved by sliced file reads, batched searches, and trimmed check outputs are now counted accurately in the panel, without mixing up windows or double-counting. - **Roll up subagent savings into the main chat**: Savings from saved long docs, batch lookups, and background subagents now roll up under the main conversation so panel totals stay accurate. - **Fixed missed log filtering on Windows / PowerShell**: Commands using flags like `npm --prefix`, `pnpm -C`, `yarn --cwd`, or `--` separators now trim noisy output properly on Windows and PowerShell too. ### v1.7.0 - **Hand the AI a file map when blocking a full large-file read**: When the AI tries to read a huge code file all at once for the first time, the block message now includes a line-numbered list of functions and classes so it can jump straight to the lines it needs without an extra turn. - **Unified CLI with Claude Code & Codex support**: Added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs` to install for Antigravity, Claude Code, or Codex, print file outlines, and compare token usage across chats; also shipped lightweight built-in coding/review subagents and stronger workspace & Node.js checks. ### v1.6.0 - **4 core tools preloaded directly, fixing occasional dropped multi-file edits**: Batch search, file outlines, multi-file edits, and quick checks now load directly instead of going through an extra layer that sometimes emptied multi-file edits; the other 8 large-log tools stay on-demand to save startup context. - **Fixed Auto-Keepalive stalls & skipped all background subagents**: The background panel now restarts cleanly after plugin updates so stale processes don't interfere; subagents spawned by `/boost`, browser tasks, or workflows — plus closed chats — never send keepalive pings or crowd the top status bar. - **Let subagents read freely & protect the plugin folder**: Background subagents can read large or repeated files without hitting red block messages, and any call missing a project path that lands inside the plugin's own install folder is blocked so the AI won't search or edit the plugin by mistake. - **One-line install without cloning**: Added single-line PowerShell and Shell commands so you don't have to clone the repo first. - **Other polish**: Unused output budget from short checks automatically shifts to long error traces; read-only Git queries block untrusted external commands; fixed Windows hang on exit; upgrades preserve your custom `rules/*.local.md` files; added a security policy and light/dark architecture diagrams. ### v1.5.4 - **Click alerts to jump to that chat**: Clicking a desktop popup or cross-window panel alert brings the matching project window to the front and opens that conversation; added a multi-window session switcher bar in the panel. - **Optional cache keepalive** sends a ping for primary chats shortly before expiry. The panel controls the per-chat limit. Your next message resets the count. - Moved current context usage, cache countdown, and blocked noise volume into a larger top card in the panel. ### v1.5.3 - **Project & chat titles on multi-window alerts**: Desktop popups and panel alerts show folder names (e.g., `work/agy-dart`) and short chat titles without exposing message text. - **"Context Almost Full" desktop alert**: Pops up once near the limit and resets after `/compact`. ### v1.5.2 - Faster file reads and chat startup; added code outlines for multi-thousand-line `.html` / `.astro` and `.dart` files; fixed Windows Python / PowerShell encoding garbling and paused panel refreshes while hidden. ### v1.5.1 - Filled in untranslated strings in Chinese UI mode; tuned post-edit file-limit suggestions. ### v1.5.0 - **Read actual model cache expiry time**: Reads the active model's real cache lifetime (such as 5m or 15m) from recent usage and carries it into new chats. - Added optional 1-minute cache-expiry desktop reminder and CLI keepalive cost simulation. ### v1.4.0 - **Hang detection & rescue summary**: Flags chats stuck spinning with zero output (ignoring long builds and laptop sleep), points to the stalled step in the panel, and prepares a one-click progress summary (modified files, last command, current step) to continue in a new chat. ### v1.3.1 - Allow immediate file re-reads right after `/compact`; --- ## 这个 Google Antigravity 插件是干什么的？ `agy-dart` 是专为 **Google Antigravity** 打造的性能、缓存与上下文管理插件（同时支持通过 `--target` 安装到 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code 与 Codex）：减少重复读取和过长的工具输出，查看缓存用量，会话占满上下文或卡住时可以把进度带到新对话。 装好之后在后台自动生效，不用记新命令，平时照常打字聊天就行： ### 1. 整合动作 AI 要搜好几个词时一次同时搜完，要改多个文件时一次改完并顺手跑完测试，少跑好几轮重复带上下文的请求。 ### 2. 挡住废话 跑一次测试吐出 3000 行日志，插件只挑关键那几句给 AI（比如第 42 行报错，其余 199 个通过），完整原文存进本地备查。遇到几千行的大代码文件，先拉目录再读要改的那几十行。 ### 3. 缓存监测与按需续温 插件在客户端侧稳定可控前缀，并减少短时间内重复读取未修改的文件；实际缓存命中率仍取决于宿主构造请求的方式及后端缓存行为（若排查动态代理分流影响，可固定单一出口作为有对照的排查实验）。自动续温和缓存到期桌面提醒默认关闭。首次开启续温时，每段对话最多自动请求 1 次，发新消息后重新计数。次数可在面板里调整。 ### 4. 右侧面板与崩溃/卡死抢救 右侧边栏面板直接显示：上下文还有多少、缓存还剩几分钟过期、挡掉了多少废话。 多开项目窗口时，哪个后台窗口上下文快满了，或者一直转圈不出字，右下角会弹窗标明是哪个窗口、哪段对话，点一下弹窗直接切过去。会话真因为爆上下文崩掉或卡死时，在面板点一下复制当前进度摘要，贴到新对话接着往下做。 ### 其他内置功能 1. **压缩对话（`/compact`）后恢复上下文线索**：后台记录本轮改过哪些文件、最近一次测试或打包过没过、存过哪些参考资料。跑完 `/compact` 后 AI 可以直接调出这份记录接着做。 2. **长文档与网页存本地检索**：几万字的开发文档或网页可以先按章节存进本地数据库，后面用到哪段按关键词搜哪段。 3. **大日志与大表格先在本地跑脚本筛选**：遇到几十 MB 的日志、CSV 或几万行 JSON，AI 可以在本地沙盒跑几行脚本先做统计（比如筛出报错最多的 5 个接口），只把算出来的结果发回对话；大 JSON 还会自动摘出报错的异常条。 4. **新对话自动附带目录结构**：刚开对话时自动给出一份精简的项目目录、脚本和核心文件清单。 5. **死循环提示**：AI 连续出现「改代码 → 报错 → 改回去 → 又报错」或反复调同一个工具没进展时，在聊天界面弹一行只给用户看的提示（不塞进模型上下文）。 6. **密钥打码、敏感文件与 Git 沙盒防护**：日志或网页里的 API Key、口令自动打码；可拦截 AI 误读 `.env` 等配置文件，并封堵陌生仓库 `.git/config` 挂载外部命令的入口。 7. **单次返回卡在 8.8 KB 以内（智能匀配额）**：Antigravity 工具单次返回超过约 10 KB 会自动落成临时文件让 AI 多读一轮；插件把返回内容控制在 8.8 KB 内，并自动把短检查省下的空间让给真正报错的长堆栈。 8. **面板细分统计与离线测算**：右侧面板能查看上下文花在读文件、终端输出还是子智能体上，以及最近 15 轮缓存命中走势和失效原因；可选开启大文件修改后只读改动行（默认关闭）；命令行支持拿历史记录测算缓存命中与自动续期账本。 9. **和各类 Skill 放心叠加，还能体检它们占了多少额度**：平时装的各类 Skill 照常管流程，插件在底层负责防盲读大文件、压刷屏日志和保缓存，互不打架；跑一句 `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills`，就能一键查出本机装的所有 Skill 各自占了多少开场上下文、有没有把大段参考资料全塞进主说明里。 > Antigravity 官方更新很勤，可以点一下右上角 --- ## What does this Google Antigravity plugin do? `agy-dart` is a performance, KV-cache, and context-window plugin for **Google Antigravity** (also supports DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex via `--target`). It reduces repeated reads and large tool results, shows prompt-cache usage, and helps you resume work in a new chat when a session fills up or stalls. Once installed, it runs automatically in the background — no new commands to learn, just chat and code as usual: ### 1. Combine actions When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs tests in the same step instead of resending your full chat context across half a dozen turns. ### 2. Block noise If a test run prints 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the lines that matter to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and stores the full log locally for lookup. On multi-thousand-line code files, it pulls the outline first and reads only the target lines. ### 3. Cache monitoring and optional keepalive The plugin stabilizes controllable client-side prefixes and reduces repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how the host constructs requests and on backend caching behavior (if you use a dynamic proxy pool, pinning a single exit node can serve as a controlled troubleshooting experiment). Automatic keepalive and desktop expiry alerts start off. If you enable keepalive, the initial limit is one ping per chat until your next message. You can change the limit in the panel. ### 4. Side panel & crash/hang rescue The right-sidebar panel shows: remaining context space, minutes until cache expiry, and total noise blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background window is nearly out of context or stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop popup names that exact project and chat — click the popup to jump straight there. If a session crashes from blown-out context or hangs completely, click once in the panel to copy a progress summary and paste it into a new chat to continue. ### Other built-in features 1. **Restore context clues after `/compact`**: Records modified files, latest test/build pass status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI can pick back up right after `/compact`. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Stores multi-thousand-word docs or web pages by section in a local database and fetches only matching sections by keyword. 3. **Local script filtering for giant logs & tables**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a short local script to compute counts or extract rows (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and returns only the result; large JSON outputs also surface error rows automatically. 4. **Workspace layout on new chats**: Supplies a compact directory, script, and core-file summary at the start of a new conversation. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (not injected into model context) when the AI repeats `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles or calls the same tool with no progress. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file blocking**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or fetched pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and sandboxes read-only `git` queries against untrusted `.git/config` hooks. 7. **Hard 8.8 KB response cap with dynamic quota**: Antigravity spills tool outputs above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; all plugin responses stay within 8.8 KB, dynamically giving short passing checks' unused space to failing stack traces. 8. **Detailed panel breakdown & offline simulation**: Inspect context usage across file reads, terminal output, and subagents, check 15-turn cache hit trends and miss causes, optionally read only changed lines after edits (off by default), or replay past chat history via CLI to measure cache hit rates and keepalive cost. 9. **Works smoothly alongside your Skills, plus a Skills bloat check**: Use it with any Skills in Antigravity, Claude Code, or Codex — your Skills guide the workflow while `agy-dart` quietly blocks giant file reads, trims noisy logs, and looks after your cache; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to see how much startup context each installed Skill uses and spot oversized main files. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Use **Node.js 22.16.0 or later in the 22.x line, or Node.js 24 or later**. The installer checks that the built-in SQLite supports FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer. The plugin uses only built-in modules. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.8/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.7.8/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.7.8 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.7.8 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. User-created `rules/*.local.md` files inside the plugin directory are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Indexed content and usage history are stored locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` by default and survive uninstall. Before uninstalling, `ctx_purge` can clear the current chat's index. When the host omits a session ID, this covers anonymous data for the confirmed workspace. To clear indexed data and history across all projects, call `ctx_purge` with `scope: "all"`. Global uninstall also removes the Gemini/T3 copies recorded by the installer. If an older copy has no ownership record, the installer prints its location and a command for removing that copy explicitly. --- ## Settings Automatic cache warming is off by default. To turn it on for a chat, enable **Auto-Keepalive** in the **agy-dart Context** panel — or click **Warm 1×** next to the countdown anytime for a single manual ping. **Global Warm** sets the default count and timing (**Auto**, **Fixed 4 / 9 / 15 min**, or **Custom 1–60 min**) for chats that haven't picked their own. Turning warming off for a chat silences its expiry and limit desktop alerts. Desktop alerts for stalled chats are also off by default and can be enabled separately. Each warm-up asks the model for a short `OK` reply and uses input tokens (or the full conversation if the cache already expired). The panel also controls desktop alerts, pausing protection, local cleanup, and file-size limits. Preset modes & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ``` > **Troubleshooting (`ide-tools` duplicate `/required` error):** If Antigravity fails during toolbox initialization with `building toolbox: tool "mcp_ide-tools_mcp_agy-dart_fast_apply_edits" advertises an invalid parameter schema ... at '/required': items at 1 and 2 are equal`, the host's `ide-tools` bridge is re-wrapping already-eager `mcp_agy-dart_fast_*` tools and appending `toolSummary` to `/required` a second time without deduplicating (`agy-dart` itself only declares `"required": ["edits"]`). Switch to lazy loading and restart Antigravity: > > ```bash > node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy > ``` > > (Or remove `"tools"` / `"eager": true` under `mcpServers.fast` in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/mcp_config.json` and restart. See [skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md](skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md) for diagnostics.) --- ## Changelog ### v1.7.8 - **Opt-in silent auto-updates (default OFF)**: Added an `Auto-Update: OFF/ON` toggle in the dashboard topbar (also configurable via `autoUpdateInstall` in `~/.agy-dart/config.json` or `AGY_DART_AUTO_UPDATE_INSTALL` / `AGY_DART_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE_INSTALL`). passing an unrelated test or a single test case won't erase an earlier full-suite failure; background test errors stay visible even after editing other files; and if a failing check log gets cut off, the panel keeps flagging it until you re-run it. - **Cleaner handoff summaries & clearer cache-miss reasons**: Copy cleaner progress summaries before switching chats or compacting (with secrets auto-masked), and see more accurate reasons when the cache misses. ### v1.7.2 - **Lighter built-in skill docs & a Skills bloat check**: Moved sample scripts and troubleshooting notes into on-demand files so they don't eat startup context when unused; added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to check how much startup context each installed Skill uses and spot oversized main files. - **Leaner output from built-in helper agents**: The built-in coding (`dart-coder`) and review (`dart-reviewer`) subagents stay lightweight without carrying extra external tools or global rules, and now route quick checks through output trimming instead of dumping long terminal logs into the chat. ### v1.7.1 - **Fixed the panel's "Blocked Noise" counter staying at 0**: Bytes saved by sliced file reads, batched searches, and trimmed check outputs are now counted accurately in the panel, without mixing up windows or double-counting. - **Roll up subagent savings into the main chat**: Savings from saved long docs, batch lookups, and background subagents now roll up under the main conversation so panel totals stay accurate. - **Fixed missed log filtering on Windows / PowerShell**: Commands using flags like `npm --prefix`, `pnpm -C`, `yarn --cwd`, or `--` separators now trim noisy output properly on Windows and PowerShell too. ### v1.7.0 - **Hand the AI a file map when blocking a full large-file read**: When the AI tries to read a huge code file all at once for the first time, the block message now includes a line-numbered list of functions and classes so it can jump straight to the lines it needs without an extra turn. - **Unified CLI with Claude Code & Codex support**: Added `node bin/agy-dart.mjs` to install for Antigravity, Claude Code, or Codex, print file outlines, and compare token usage across chats; also shipped lightweight built-in coding/review subagents and stronger workspace & Node.js checks. ### v1.6.0 - **4 core tools preloaded directly, fixing occasional dropped multi-file edits**: Batch search, file outlines, multi-file edits, and quick checks now load directly instead of going through an extra layer that sometimes emptied multi-file edits; the other 8 large-log tools stay on-demand to save startup context. - **Fixed Auto-Keepalive stalls & skipped all background subagents**: The background panel now restarts cleanly after plugin updates so stale processes don't interfere; subagents spawned by `/boost`, browser tasks, or workflows — plus closed chats — never send keepalive pings or crowd the top status bar. - **Let subagents read freely & protect the plugin folder**: Background subagents can read large or repeated files without hitting red block messages, and any call missing a project path that lands inside the plugin's own install folder is blocked so the AI won't search or edit the plugin by mistake. - **One-line install without cloning**: Added single-line PowerShell and Shell commands so you don't have to clone the repo first. - **Other polish**: Unused output budget from short checks automatically shifts to long error traces; read-only Git queries block untrusted external commands; fixed Windows hang on exit; upgrades preserve your custom `rules/*.local.md` files; added a security policy and light/dark architecture diagrams. ### v1.5.4 - **Click alerts to jump to that chat**: Clicking a desktop popup or cross-window panel alert brings the matching project window to the front and opens that conversation; added a multi-window session switcher bar in the panel. - **Optional cache keepalive** sends a ping for primary chats shortly before expiry. The panel controls the per-chat limit. Your next message resets the count. - Moved current context usage, cache countdown, and blocked noise volume into a larger top card in the panel. ### v1.5.3 - **Project & chat titles on multi-window alerts**: Desktop popups and panel alerts show folder names (e.g., `work/agy-dart`) and short chat titles without exposing message text. - **"Context Almost Full" desktop alert**: Pops up once near the limit and resets after `/compact`. ### v1.5.2 - Faster file reads and chat startup; added code outlines for multi-thousand-line `.html` / `.astro` and `.dart` files; fixed Windows Python / PowerShell encoding garbling and paused panel refreshes while hidden. ### v1.5.1 - Filled in untranslated strings in Chinese UI mode; tuned post-edit file-limit suggestions. ### v1.5.0 - **Read actual model cache expiry time**: Reads the active model's real cache lifetime (such as 5m or 15m) from recent usage and carries it into new chats. - Added optional 1-minute cache-expiry desktop reminder and CLI keepalive cost simulation. ### v1.4.0 - **Hang detection & rescue summary**: Flags chats stuck spinning with zero output (ignoring long builds and laptop sleep), points to the stalled step in the panel, and prepares a one-click progress summary (modified files, last command, current step) to continue in a new chat. ### v1.3.1 - Allow immediate file re-reads right after `/compact`; skip dedup prompts on slices under 4 KB; preserve mid-log error lines in long failure outputs. ### v1.3.0 - **Tiered file-read limits**: Raised direct reads to 45 KB (800 lines) for normal code and 128 KB for `.patch` files while keeping noisy logs at 16 KB; second-try reads pass through so patch reviews and subagents don't stall. - Added `.patch` file outlines and kept context lines when trimming `git diff`. ### v1.2.2 - **Uninterrupted long tasks**: Removed mid-task `/compact` prompts and routed >60s builds, tests, and background servers straight to Antigravity's native background runner. - Blocked `.env` reads and fixed 42 Windows shell, isolation, and orphan-process issues. ### v1.2.1 - Automatic rollback on failed multi-file edits and 76 path/argument stability fixes. ### v1.2.0 - Unified settings in `~/.agy-dart/config.json`; added local panel request checks; **automatic structure, sample, and error extraction for huge JSON files**; added `gh`, `kubectl`, `terraform`, and `playwright` output trimming plus handoff summaries. ### v1.1.0 - **Automatic terminal output trimming**: Strips progress bars and repetitive noise from `git`, test, build, and install commands while saving full logs locally. - Unchanged-file duplicate-read protection, edit-fail loop notes, internal-URL SSRF blocking, log secret masking, and one-click panel cleanup. --- ## Local Checks ```bash npm test # Run full test suite npm run verify:pkg # Verify installer file list npm run prefix:budget # Estimate configured Antigravity startup and full-catalog token usage npm run brief:check # Check that AI_REVIEW_BRIEF.md line/test counts are up to date node scripts/cache-audit.mjs --workspace . --no-live node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills --workspace . # Check startup context usage and structure of installed Skills npm run cache:simulate ``` After adding, removing, or editing modules or tests, keep these three places in sync so local checks stay green: - **Installer file list** (`scripts/install.mjs`): update `RUNTIME_FILES` (installed by default) or `DEVTOOLS_FILES` (`--with-devtools`) whenever files are added or removed, or `npm run verify:pkg` will fail. - **Test count check** (`tests/v1.2-hardening.test.mjs`): when the test count changes, update the hardcoded `computeBriefMetrics(ROOT).testCases` number to match `npm test`. - **Review brief** (`AI_REVIEW_BRIEF.md`): after changing tracked source files or test counts, run `node scripts/gen-review-brief.mjs --write` to refresh the numbers, then verify with `npm run brief:check`. --- ## Credits & License [MIT License](LICENSE). Incorporates and adapts MIT-licensed code from [INK-Q/agy-fast](https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast) and [Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode](https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode); full third-party notices are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## CLI (Antigravity / DeepSeek Harness / Claude Code / Codex) `node bin/agy-dart.mjs` installs for Antigravity by default; pass `--target dsh` (optional `--profile ` / `--mcp-only`), `--target claude`, or `--target codex` for DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, or Codex. For DeepSeek Harness, `--target dsh` mounts both MCP servers (`agy_dart_fast` & `agy_dart_context`), the zero-dependency native Cordis guard plugin (`dsh/plugin.mjs`), and `~/.dsh/skills/agy-dart/`; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs dashboard` to open the live Web dashboard standalone. You can also run `outline ` to print a file's function map with line numbers, `session ` to inspect one chat's token bill, or `compare ` to compare two chats. When installing for DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, or Codex, the installer saves an undo record in `~/.agy-dart/-install.json` so uninstalling cleanly restores your original config. ```sh git clone --branch v1.7.8 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart node bin/agy-dart.mjs install node bin/agy-dart.mjs doctor ``` --- ## Star History

# AGY Market · 反重力插件市场 (`agy-market`) **Google Antigravity 社区插件市场** Sidebar 侧边栏界面 · 锁安全一键卸载 · Sidebar 上游直装与一键更新 · 15 大精准分类 · GitHub 完整链接预检安装 · ⭐ 插件收藏栏 · 已安装实时搜索筛选 · 一键直开 Sidebar 侧边栏 · 卡片原生启停滑块 · 本地插件冲突检查 · 双通道中国镜像加速 · SHA-256 校验 **简体中文** · [English](./README.en.md) · **[📖 申请收录插件教程](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** · [插件目录仓库](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [架构规范](./AGENTS.md)
--- > **仓库边界说明**：本仓库（[`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)）包含 **AGY Market** 客户端 Sidebar 侧边栏、Windows 锁安全安装器、`npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market` 一行安装 CLI 与静态展示站（`site/`）。 > > 如需将你的插件收录至社区插件目录，点击市场顶部的 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 按钮或直接阅读 **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)**，向 **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** 提交单文件 YAML Pull Request。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性（v1.7.1） ### 0. v1.7.1 升级亮点 - **Track 2 极速流畅渲染与增量加载**：发现页采用 48 张卡片分页增量渲染（`IntersectionObserver` 触底自动追加 + 可见「加载更多」兜底按钮），配合卡片 `content-visibility: auto` 视口隔离、移除每张卡片高开销 `backdrop-filter` / `filter: blur` 合成层、根容器事件委托、150ms 搜索防抖与 `requestAnimationFrame` 光斑节流，开启近千个 Track 2 插件后依然丝滑流畅。 - **修复 Track 2 开关偶发无响应与并发回跳**：将 `#track2-checkbox` 从后台更新检查全局锁彻底解耦（仅在自身保存期间显示「切换中…」加载态并防重入），配置保存改用乐观更新与失败自动回滚，Toast 通知使用独立挂载节点更新不再触发全量卡片重建，并为 `loadState` / `updatePrefs` 及后端目录加载增加请求序号与缓存回退保护。
查看 v1.7.0 既有特性（系统代理自动适配 / 无上限流式大插件 / Monorepo 更新防误判 / Release 自动化） - **零依赖 HTTP/HTTPS 与 Windows 系统代理自动适配**：新增 `src/shared/proxy-fetch.mjs` 代理感知网络层，自动读取 `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY`（支持 `NO_PROXY` 并旁路 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost`）以及 Windows 注册表系统代理（`HKCU\...\Internet Settings`），彻底解决仅开启本地代理未开 TUN 时 GitHub 归档拉取超时问题。 - **取消 100 MB 插件大小门禁与全流式解压校验**：移除 `MAX_TARBALL_BYTES` 人为 `100 MB` 归档上限（设为无限制 `0`），改为全流式 Gunzip + POSIX/PAX Tar 落盘解包（O(MB) 内存占用）、`60s` 分块静默失活超时与 `server.requestTimeout = 0`，并新增 `GB` 体积显示，轻松支持 >100MB 乃至 GB 级含本地二进制/模型资源的插件。 - **Monorepo / 原生 Git / 无版本插件更新防误判**：更新检测对未收录、无收据的外部 Monorepo 插件（如 `upstash/context7`）核验远端 Tag 对应子目录 `plugin.json` 是否存在及版本是否真正领先；同时自动识别含 `.git` 目录的原生克隆插件（`conductor`、`sepia` 等）及无 `version` 声明插件，将其移出自动与批量更新队列并在卡片/抽屉展示只读「`Git 原生` / `无版本号`」胶囊，杜绝误报降级与软链拦截报错。 - **`app.asar` 补丁脚本引导与 `preservePaths` 合并保留**：安装或更新含 `app-asar` 宿主增强的插件后，弹窗、顶部横幅与详情抽屉明确提示先按插件文档运行其自带补丁脚本（如 `node setup.cjs`）再重启 Antigravity，并在每次市场更新后重新运行补丁脚本同步注入客户端代码，同时提供一键「复制插件目录」与「查看补丁文档」按钮；目录安装通道同步合并已有 `.agy-market-receipt.json` 与目录声明的 `preservePaths`，升级时保护用户配置不被覆盖。 - **`npx` GitHub 引导入口修复与 Release 自动化**：将尚未发布至 npm 的旧 `npx` 包名入口统一替换为直接可运行的 `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market`，修复 `scripts/install-local.mjs` 在 `_npx/.../node_modules/agy-market` 缓存路径下因全路径匹配 `node_modules` 误过滤全部文件的缺陷；新增 `.github/workflows/release.yml` 在推送 `v*` 标签时自动打包并发布 `agy-market.tar.gz` 与 `.sha256` 至 GitHub Releases。
查看 v1.6.0 既有特性（综合推荐排序 / 按需 README 缓存 / 作用域符号链接 / 零 PII 提名） - **默认「综合推荐」排序 + Monorepo 视口展位阻尼**：默认按目录质量评分（`ranking.score`，旧目录/自定义源自动回退 `stars`）排序，并对同一 `repositoryId` 的 Monorepo 子插件应用 `1 / (1 + 0.15 * (k - 1))` 阻尼，避免单一多插件仓库霸占首页前排；保留按星标、最近更新、名称排序。 - **按需单插件 README 懒加载与本地 ETag 缓存**：详情抽屉与 `GET /api/readme` / `GET /api/plugin/:id/readme` 优先按需拉取 `dist/readmes/.json`（独立 ETag 缓存于 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/cache/readmes/.json`），无缝回退至传统 `readmes.json`、中国大陆 npm 镜像或已安装本地 README。 - **子目录作用域符号链接兼容（不降级安全红线）**：对位于所选 `pluginRoot` 之外的仓库符号链接（如双宿主 `.claude/` 或 `docs/` 软链）自动跳过不再误报阻断；`pluginRoot` 内部、祖先目录、目标穿越进入 `pluginRoot` 或根目录插件（`pluginRoot === '.'`）的任何符号链接仍一律硬拦截 `ERR_TAR_SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN`。 - **零 PII 公开插件一键社区提名**：通过「链接添加」安装未收录的公开 GitHub 仓库时，经无鉴权 `HEAD` 确认公开后展示非阻塞的「分享此公开插件到 AGY Market？」引导（私有/404 仓库永不提示），预填 GitHub Issue 仅包含 `owner/repo` 与 `plugin_root`。
### 1. Sidebar 侧边栏界面、15 大精准分类与导航体验 - **原生右侧 Sidebar 侧边栏**：基于 Antigravity 原生 `AUX_PANE` 扩展视图（`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`），不捆绑常驻 MCP 服务，打开即用、轻量流畅。 - **15 大精准分类体系（含 `all` 共 16 项）**：新增 **状态与用量监控（`monitoring-quota`）**、**上下文与缓存加速（`context-cache`）**、**多代理与思考控制（`agents-reasoning`）** 等高辨识度细分品类；探索页自动按目录数据动态生成分类胶囊、支持按中英文分类名实时搜索并在卡片与详情抽屉展示分类微标签。 - **顶部概览栏与插件卡片**：顶部可折叠概览栏实时展示「已收录插件 / 运行中 / 可更新 / 本地冲突」，顶栏内置 **`链接添加`**（粘贴任意 GitHub 链接预检安装）与 **`+ 申请收录插件`** 快捷入口；卡片样式适配暗色、亮色与半透明壁纸皮肤（如 Wallpaper Prism）。 - **双行标题 + 一键直达 GitHub**：点击探索卡片、收藏卡片、已安装卡片或详情抽屉的**插件标题**可直接在新窗口打开对应 GitHub 仓库，点击卡片其余区域展开详情抽屉。 - **开箱优先呈现简体中文文档**：详情抽屉请求 `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh`，自动优先渲染目录源 `entriesZh` 或本地 `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md`，并在已安装卡片优先显示中文化简介。 - **点击「面板」一键直开目标 Sidebar 侧边栏**：移除会被 Chromium 拦截的裸 `` 链接；在宿主侧边栏内点击其他 Sidebar 插件卡片上的「面板」按钮时，直接调用宿主 `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane`（`tabType: "sidecarView"`）拉起或聚焦对应侧边栏，无需手动复制提示。 ### 2. 锁安全一键卸载、Sidebar 全通道直装更新与按需「一键更新」 - **彻底杜绝同版本无效更新（v1.5.4）**：前后端共享 SemVer 严格对账与服务端最新目录源优先机制，消除跨快照状态失步导致的 `vX.Y.Z → vX.Y.Z` 误报与陈旧数据降级重装；常规更新命中已最新或同 Tag/Commit 时免下载短路返回 `ALREADY_UP_TO_DATE`，详情抽屉保留显式「重新同步（`forceResync`）」能力。 - **锁安全插件卸载（Sidebar 卡片/详情抽屉 + `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall `）**： - **零改写 `config.json` 红线**：Antigravity 语言服务器对 `~/.gemini/config/config.json` 设有写保护。AGY Market 严守只读原则，永不改写 `config.json`，而是通过**安全停放仓（Vault Parking）**实现即时启停控制（`POST /api/toggle-plugin`）： - **滑向「禁用（OFF）」**：后端将 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 安全移入 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`，宿主热监听约 1 秒内卸载对应 Skills / Rules / Hooks。 - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场侧边栏内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 5. 本地插件冲突检查与修复 顶部内置独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），对本地已安装插件执行只读静态检查，并提供一键修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 检测项 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 警告 / 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时修改 `app.asar`（**警告**，需注意文件补丁叠加风险）或同时使用 `cdp` 宿主界面增强（**提示**，通常可共存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 6. 按需触发的智能重启 / 重开侧边栏提示 卡片与详情抽屉保持视觉清爽，不再堆叠静态「需重启 / 免重启」标签；**仅当安装、更新、批量更新、卸载完成或 Windows 禁用遇到文件锁时**，依据插件能力与实时句柄状态按需弹出精准提示： - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关与 SHA-256 校验下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会比对目录源中的 `sha256` 摘要，不匹配时立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用，直连 GitHub 零 npm 发布依赖） ```bash npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - **滑向「启用（ON）」**：后端将目录完整移回 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 并清理可能残留的 `"disabled": true`。 - **停放态持续可更新**：被禁用的插件仍保留在「已安装」与「探索」卡片中；对其执行版本更新时，会在 `disabled-plugins/` 内原位同步，绝不意外将其自动重新激活。 - **防误操作锁定**：`agy-market` 自身滑块保持常亮锁定（避免在市场侧边栏内把自己停用断连）；`workspace`、`builtin` 及宿主手动禁用项显示只读锁定提示。 ### 5. 本地插件冲突检查与修复 顶部内置独立 **「冲突与诊断」** 标签页（`GET /api/conflicts`），对本地已安装插件执行只读静态检查，并提供一键修复（`POST /api/fix-conflict`）： | 检测项 | 严重级别 | 检测内容 | 一键修复能力 | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | 严重 | 跨 `workspace > global > builtin` 扫描重复 `plugin.json.name`，精确标出生效胜出方与被宿主静默丢弃的插件目录 | 一键双连字符隔离重命名（`--`） | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | 严重 | 检测 Windows 下 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` 中被 `GetAllPlugins` 静默跳过的 NTFS Junction / 符号链接目录 | 一键实体化转为真实目录 | | `mcp-collision` | 严重 / 警告 | 检测重复 `_`、与用户全局 `mcp_config.json` 重名或裸通用服务名（如 `search`、`db`、`fetch`） | 定位冲突键名与来源文件 | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | 警告 | 检测已启用插件之间的 `skills/*/SKILL.md`、`agents/*.md` 与用户全局目录或内置保留名的覆盖链 | 完整展示胜出/被覆盖链路 | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | 警告 / 提示 | 检测多个已启用插件同时修改 `app.asar`（**警告**，需注意文件补丁叠加风险）或同时使用 `cdp` 宿主界面增强（**提示**，通常可共存） | 提示评估是否停用其一 | ### 6. 按需触发的智能重启 / 重开侧边栏提示 卡片与详情抽屉保持视觉清爽，不再堆叠静态「需重启 / 免重启」标签；**仅当安装、更新、批量更新、卸载完成或 Windows 禁用遇到文件锁时**，依据插件能力与实时句柄状态按需弹出精准提示： - **纯声明式技能 / 全局规则（`instant`）**：热加载即刻生效，免重启无打扰。 - **含 Sidebar 侧边栏 / MCP / 钩子（`reload-pane`）**：更新或安装成功后提示重开侧边栏或刷新 MCP。 - **含 `app.asar` / 首次配置 `cdp` / Windows 锁定退避文件（`host-restart`）**：操作完成后弹出顶部横幅提醒重启 Antigravity 生效；其中涉及 `app.asar` 补丁的插件会明确提示安装与每次更新后需先按插件文档运行自带补丁脚本（如 `node setup.cjs`）再重启客户端，并提供一键复制插件目录与查看文档按钮。 ### 7. 内置 GitHub Discussions 社区讨论 - 插件详情抽屉内置 **「讨论」** 标签页（`GET /api/discussions`），无需登录或 Token 即可自动探测目标仓库是否开启 GitHub Discussions，并提供一键直达讨论区与发帖入口。 - 如在面板设置中可选填入个人 GitHub Token（仅以 `0600` 权限保存在本地 `prefs.json`，绝不写入缓存文件或日志），即可在侧边栏直接拉取并浏览该插件最新 10 条社区讨论。 ### 8. 双通道中国大陆镜像加速与 SHA-256 校验 - **三级目录源自动解析（零内置陈旧快照）**： 1. **自定义团队/个人源**：优先合并 `prefs.json` 中配置的静态 `index.json` 订阅源。 2. **全球主通道（GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw 回退）**：支持 `ETag`（`If-None-Match`）/ `If-Modified-Since` 条件请求，`304 Not Modified` 毫秒级复用本地缓存。 3. **中国大陆自动镜像回退**：主源超时（`> 3.5s`）或不可达时，自动切换拉取纯 JSON 数据包 `@agy-market/catalog`（依次尝试 `registry.npmmirror.com` 与 `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm`），在内存流式解包目录索引；完全离线时自动降级为本地磁盘缓存。 - **语言无关与 SHA-256 校验下载**：`@agy-market/catalog` 仅将 npm 用作静态 JSON CDN，被收录的插件**无需是 npm 包或 JS 项目**。支持配置自定义 GitHub Release 镜像加速前缀，所有 `.tar.gz` 安装包在解压前都会比对目录源中的 `sha256` 摘要，不匹配时立即触发 `INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` 中止安装。 --- ## 🚀 一行快速安装 > 运行环境要求：**Node.js >= 22.0.0**（零外部 npm 运行时依赖）；或使用下方免 npm 系统脚本。 ### 方式一：Node / `npx`（推荐，全平台通用，直连 GitHub 零 npm 发布依赖） ```bash npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market ``` ### 方式二：Windows PowerShell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` ### 方式三：macOS / Linux Shell（免 npm，内置 SHA-256 校验与目录回退） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` ### 安装后如何在 Antigravity 中打开？ - 在 Antigravity 对话中发送「打开插件市场」，或点击聊天药丸：`[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` - 也可直接点击右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏顶部 **`+` → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`** 打开。 - 如需在 Antigravity 原生定制页管理本插件，可点击对话药丸：`[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 通过 GitHub 完整链接添加插件 无需等待目录收录，v1.4.0 起可直接通过 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装任意社区插件，自动兼容单插件子目录、Monorepo 多插件目录及无 Release Tag 的默认分支提交。 ### 方式一：UI 顶栏「链接添加」按钮（两步式预检安装） 1. 打开 AGY Market 侧边栏，点击顶栏右上角 **`链接添加`** 按钮（或在探索页搜索无结果时点击 **「通过 GitHub 链接添加」**）。 2. 粘贴任意 GitHub 完整链接并点击 **「解析预检」**，支持以下链接形式： - 仓库主页：`https://github.com//`（自动按最新 Release → Git Tag → 默认分支提交解析） - 分支或子目录：`https://github.com///tree//` - 清单文件直链：`https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - 指定 Release / 标签 / 归档直链：`/releases/tag/`、`/releases/latest`、`/releases/download//.tar.gz`、`/archive/...tar.gz` 3. 后端在插件外置暂存目录下载归档并完成本地静态检查： - **自动识别布局**：兼容根目录 `plugin.json`、`.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`、唯一命名子目录自动定位（如 `agy-capsule/plugin.json`）；若仓库为 Monorepo 多插件布局（如 `plugins/*`、`.agents/plugins/*`），弹窗将列出全部候选子目录供直接点选。 - **预检与安全拦截**：安装前明确展示版本号或短 `commitSha`、SHA-256 摘要、能力徽章及安装方式（原生目录名或 `--` 隔离目录名）；若仓库不含有效 `plugin.json` 或命中路径穿越、软硬链接、规则越界注入等安全规则，将提示原因并清理暂存目录，不产生残留。 - **已安装联动更新**：通过链接安装的插件在「已安装」页带有 `GitHub URL` 来源标签，支持滑块启停、详情抽屉查看，并可按 Release Tag 或分支最新 Commit SHA 一键检查更新。 ### 方式二：CLI `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add ` ```bash # 预检并交互确认安装任意 GitHub 插件仓库（兼容子目录与无 Tag 默认分支） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com// # 指定 Monorepo 子目录，使用 -- 隔离目录名并跳过交互确认 npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # 可选参数：--replace（替换同源目录）、--dest 、--mirror 、--token 、--json npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ 能力徽章与升级权限增量确认 所有插件在点击「安装」前都会展示静态扫描生成的能力徽章： | 徽章标识 | 默认中文标签 | 含义说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 纯声明式技能` | 仅包含 `skills/` 或 `agents/` 声明文档，无后台常驻进程或钩子 | | `global-rules` | `🔵 常驻规则 (~N tok)` | 包含启用期间常驻注入上下文的 `rules/*.md`，清晰标出预估 Token 占用 | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar 侧边栏` | 在右侧 Sidebar 辅助栏提供可视化交互界面 | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 本地 MCP 进程` | 通过 `mcp_config.json` 启动本地 Stdio 工具服务进程 | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 远程 MCP 服务` | 连接外部 HTTPS MCP 服务端点（展示目标域名） | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 生命周期钩子 (Hooks)` | 通过 `hooks.json` 订阅会话或工具调用生命周期事件 | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 宿主界面增强` | 使用本地 CDP 调试桥或 `app.asar` 工作台界面增强（如毛玻璃皮肤、桌面挂件），社区完全欢迎，仅温和提示 | - **升级能力增量确认（T+N Escalation Guard）**：当插件从旧版本升级并**新增**之前未授予的能力类别或新的远程 MCP 域名时，自动弹出增量对比确认框，经用户确认后再同步写入并更新 `.agy-market-receipt.json`。 - **双轨插件支持**：默认展示 Track 1 已验证目录；在设置中可按需开启 **Track 2 实验性 Topic 自动发现**（自动强制 `--` 双连字符命名隔离，避免同名冲突）。 --- ## 🛠️ CLI 诊断与本地开发命令 ### 用户 CLI 命令（`bin/agy-market.mjs`） ```bash # 安装或更新 AGY Market 到默认插件目录（支持 --dest 自定义路径） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market install # 通过任意 GitHub 完整链接预检并安装插件（支持 --subpath / --isolate / --replace / --yes / --dest / --mirror / --token / --json） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add # 锁安全卸载已安装的全局社区插件（别名 remove；支持 --yes / --dest / --json） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall --yes --json # 查看当前配置路径、数据目录及所有已安装插件状态（支持 --json 机器可读输出） npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market status npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market status --json # 运行安装检查（校验 Node >= 22、非符号链接实体目录、10 字段清单纯净度、UI 产物）并清理 Windows 残留 *.old. 文件 npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market doctor ``` ### 源码构建与本地开发 ```powershell # 1. 编译离线可用的单文件 Sidebar UI（sidecars/market_pane/index.html）及静态展示站 npm run build # 2. 以真实文件复制方式安装至 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market（严禁符号链接 / NTFS Junction） npm run install:local # 3. 执行安装检查 node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # 4. 打包确定性 GitHub Release 压缩包与校验文件（dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256） npm run pack:release # 5. 运行全量单元测试与跨仓集成测试 npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 安全与宿主工程红线 - **绝不写入 `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**：仅只读解析插件启停状态，杜绝覆盖用户登录态与设置。 - **绝不创建符号链接 / NTFS Junction**：Windows 下 Antigravity 会静默跳过符号链接插件，所有安装/更新均为实体目录复制，且解包器硬性拦截 `..` 路径穿越与软硬链接。 - **Windows 锁安全原位更新与崩溃恢复**：先在插件外置 `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/` 解包并写入 `pending-journal.json`（启动 8 秒自动恢复中断事务），对 Windows 锁定中的二进制采用 `.old.` 改名退避并在下次启动时由 `retired-binaries.json` 自动垃圾回收。 - **严格环回与 CSRF 鉴权**：本地 HTTP 服务仅绑定 `127.0.0.1` 随机端口，所有写入/变更接口（`POST` / `DELETE`）强制校验 256-bit 随机 `X-Sidecar-Token` 与 `Origin` 头。 --- ## 📚 架构文档与收录指引 - **[📖 申请收录插件完整教程 (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — 一文搞定 Track 1 单文件 YAML 提交流程与 Track 2 免 PR 自动发现 - **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** — 客户端工程规范、宿主红线与锁安全安装器设计 - **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** — 跨仓库协议、统一 JSON Schema 与双层防冲突规范 - **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)** — 插件目录仓库与自动化收录管线 ## 📄 许可证 [MIT License](./LICENSE)

# AGY Market (`agy-market`) **Community Plugin Marketplace for Google Antigravity** Sidebar Panel UI · Lock-Safe One-Click Uninstall · Direct In-Sidebar Upstream & Batch Updates · 15 Precision Categories · GitHub URL Preflight Installer · ⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Tab · Live Installed Search & Filters · One-Click Sidebar Launcher · Native Vault-Parking Toggle Sliders · Local Conflict Checks · Dual-Mirror China Acceleration · SHA-256 Verified Installs [简体中文](./README.md) · **English** · **[📖 Submit a Plugin Guide](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** · [Plugin Catalog](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog) · [Architecture Spec](./AGENTS.md)
--- > **Repository Boundary**: This repository ([`azwosile/agy-market`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market)) houses the **AGY Market** Sidebar client plugin, Windows lock-safe tarball installer, `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market` bootstrap CLI, and static web showcase (`site/`). > > To list your plugin in the community catalog, click **`+ Submit Plugin`** (`+ 申请收录插件`) in AGY Market or follow the step-by-step **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** to open a single-YAML Pull Request in **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. --- ## ✨ Highlights (v1.7.1) ### 0. What's New in v1.7.1 - **Faster, Smoother Track 2 Rendering at Scale**: Discover now renders incrementally in pages of 48 cards (`IntersectionObserver` sentinel auto-append plus a visible Load More button), pairs `.plugin-card` with CSS `content-visibility: auto`, removes per-card `backdrop-filter` / `filter: blur` layers in favor of clean semi-opaque surfaces, uses root event delegation, 150ms debounced search across Discover/Favorites/Installed, and `requestAnimationFrame`-throttled card spotlight tracking. - **Responsive Track 2 Toggle & Concurrency Guards**: Decouples `#track2-checkbox` from background update-check locks (disabling only during its own in-flight save with a visible `Switching…` spinner), applies optimistic preference updates with error rollback, moves toasts to a dedicated `#toast-host` node so toast updates/dismissal never rebuild the grid, and adds `stateRequestSeq` / `prefsRequestSeq` guards alongside reliable `unverified-index.json` fetch & cache fallback.
Previous v1.7.0 Highlights (System Proxy Auto-Detect / Unlimited Streaming Installs / Monorepo Update Accuracy / Release Automation) - **Zero-Dependency HTTP/HTTPS & Windows System Proxy Support**: Adds `src/shared/proxy-fetch.mjs` respecting `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY` (with `NO_PROXY` and automatic bypass for `127.0.0.1` / `localhost`) plus Windows registry system proxy settings (`HKCU\...\Internet Settings`), preventing GitHub archive timeouts when using local proxies without TUN mode. - **Unlimited >100 MB Streaming Plugin Installs & Extraction**: Removes the artificial `100 MB` `MAX_TARBALL_BYTES` archive cap (`0 = unlimited`), switching to streaming gunzip + POSIX/PAX tar disk extraction (`extractTarGzStreamToDir`, O(MB) RAM), 60s per-chunk stall timeouts instead of fixed 60s total download ceilings, `server.requestTimeout = 0`, and `GB` size formatting in the UI. - **Monorepo, Native `.git` & Unversioned Plugin Update Accuracy**: Verifies raw `//plugin.json` existence, plugin name, and version for unreceipted/unlisted Monorepo plugins (e.g., `upstash/context7`) to prevent false-positive `github-upstream` upgrades; detects native `.git` clones (`conductor`, `sepia`, etc.) and unversioned external plugins, excluding them from auto/batch updates with read-only **Git Native / Unversioned** status pills. - **`app.asar` Patch Script Guidance & `preservePaths` Merge**: Guides users in toast notices, the restart banner, and the installed Detail Drawer to run bundled patch scripts (e.g., `node setup.cjs` per plugin docs) before restarting Antigravity and to re-run them after AGY Market updates, with one-click **Copy Plugin Folder** and **Patch Docs** actions; merges `existingReceipt.preservePaths` with `distribution.preservePaths` on catalog updates to keep user configs intact. - **`npx` GitHub Bootstrap Fix & Automated GitHub Releases**: Replaces the unpublished npm `npx` bootstrap command with `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market`, fixes `scripts/install-local.mjs` relative-path `node_modules` filtering inside `_npx` caches, and adds `.github/workflows/release.yml` to automatically pack and publish `agy-market.tar.gz` + `.sha256` assets on `v*` tag pushes.
Previous v1.6.0 Highlights (Recommended Sort / Lazy README Cache / Scoped Symlinks / Zero-PII Nomination) - **Default "Recommended" Sort + Monorepo Viewport Slot Dampening**: Sorts Discover by catalog quality score (`ranking.score`, gracefully falling back to `stars` for custom feeds or older catalogs) with `1 / (1 + 0.15 * (k - 1))` dampening across entries sharing `repository.repositoryId`, while keeping `stars`, `updated`, and `name` sort options intact. - **Lazy Per-Plugin README Loading & ETag Cache**: `GET /api/readme` and `GET /api/plugin/:id/readme` fetch `dist/readmes/.json` on demand with per-plugin ETag caching under `${PLUGIN_DATA}/cache/readmes/.json`, seamlessly falling back to monolithic `readmes.json`, China npm mirrors, or local installed READMEs. - **Security-Preserving Scoped Symlink Support**: Tarballs containing symlinks strictly outside a selected subdirectory `pluginRoot` (such as dual-host `.claude/` or `docs/` links) are skipped cleanly instead of failing installation, while any symlink inside `pluginRoot`, enclosing `pluginRoot`, targeting into `pluginRoot`, or anywhere in a root plugin (`pluginRoot === '.'`) still hard-throws `ERR_TAR_SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN`. - **Opt-In Zero-PII Public Plugin Nomination**: When Add-URL inspects or installs an unlisted public GitHub repository (verified via unauthenticated `HEAD` with 3s timeout; private/404/unreachable repos are never prompted), surfaces a non-blocking prompt opening a pre-filled GitHub Issue carrying only `owner/repo` and `plugin_root`.
### 1. Sidebar Panel UI, 15 Precision Categories & Navigation - **Native Right Sidebar Panel**: Runs inside Antigravity's native `AUX_PANE` extension view (`sidecars/market_pane/sidecar.json`) with no bundled MCP servers, keeping the panel lightweight and responsive. - **15 Precision Plugin Categories (16 Keys Including `all`)**: Adds **`monitoring-quota`** (*Telemetry & Quota*), **`context-cache`** (*Context & Cache Boost*), and **`agents-reasoning`** (*Agents & Reasoning*) alongside the existing 12 taxonomy buckets. Discover dynamically renders filter pills for all active categories, indexes localized category names in search, and displays category tags on cards and Detail Drawers. - **Overview Strip & Plugin Cards**: Collapsible top overview strip displays catalog stats (*Indexed / Active / Updates / Local Conflicts*) alongside quick **`Add URL`** (`链接添加`) and **`+ Submit Plugin`** actions. Card styles adapt across Dark, Light, and translucent wallpaper skins (such as Wallpaper Prism). - **2-Line Titles + Clickable GitHub Links**: Clicking any **plugin title** in cards or the Detail Drawer opens its GitHub repository directly in a new window, while clicking the card body opens the Detail Drawer. - **Multilingual README Drawer**: Queries `/api/readme?id=...&locale=zh|en`, preferring localized `entriesZh` / `entriesEn` from the catalog (or local `README.zh-CN.md` / `README.zh.md` for installed plugins) and rendering localized descriptions on installed cards. - **Direct One-Click Sidebar Launcher**: Replaces raw `` links blocked inside isolated iframes. Inside the host panel, clicking a sibling plugin's **Panel** button invokes host `window.sidecar.ui.toggleAuxPane` (`tabType: "sidecarView"`) directly to open or focus its Sidebar panel—no manual copy prompts. ### 2. Lock-Safe Uninstall, Direct In-Sidebar Updates & On-Demand Update All - **Zero Same-Version No-Op Updates (v1.5.4)**: Shared SemVer reconciliation across backend and UI plus server-authoritative catalog resolution eliminate stale-snapshot `vX.Y.Z → vX.Y.Z` ghost updates and stale payload downgrades; standard updates matching the installed version or Git tag/commit short-circuit cleanly with `ALREADY_UP_TO_DATE` (zero downloads), while the Detail Drawer preserves explicit **Re-sync** (`forceResync: true`) on demand. - **Lock-Safe Plugin Uninstall (Sidebar Card/Drawer + `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall `)**: - Every removable global plugin card and Detail Drawer exposes an **Uninstall** (`卸载`) button backed by `POST /api/uninstall` (with `POST /api/remove-files` compatibility) and a confirmation modal with an optional *Also remove from favorites* checkbox. - Handles both active (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/`) and Vault-Parked (`${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`) directories; never writes `config.json` or calls restricted RPCs; unlinks symlinks/NTFS junctions without touching target source directories; retires Windows `EBUSY`-locked binaries to `.old.` while immediately deleting `plugin.json` (with `sweepRetiredBinaries` later removing empty orphan shells); strictly blocks self-deletion of `agy-market` (`ERR_CANNOT_SELF_DELETE`) as well as `workspace` and `builtin` plugins. - **Direct In-Sidebar Updates Across All Channels (Zero External Download Redirects)**: - Whenever an upstream GitHub Release/Tag leads the catalog or comes from a GitHub URL install, `GET /api/updates` returns `installable: true` (`updateChannel: 'catalog' | 'github-upstream' | 'github-url'`), eliminating external browser download redirects. - Upgrading a verified catalog plugin directly from GitHub upstream preserves its original `receipt.track` (`'verified'`) and `repositoryId` while still enforcing capability-escalation confirmation. - **Per-Card Smart `Update` / `Latest` Status Pill & On-Demand Top-Bar `Update All`**: - Every installed plugin card with a catalog or GitHub source renders a clickable **Update vX.Y.Z** button when a newer version is available and automatically transitions into a non-clickable **✓ Latest** status pill once updated or confirmed up to date (before an initial check, clicking **Update** verifies first without re-downloading if already current; pure local plugins display a non-clickable `Local` / `Workspace` / `Built-in` status pill and return `ERR_NO_UPDATE_SOURCE` on API calls; native `.git` clones without a receipt and unversioned external plugins display read-only **Git Native / Unversioned** pills and are excluded from auto/batch updates). - The **Installed** tab header displays **Update All (N)** beside **Check Updates** on demand: it appears when installable updates are detected (or while a batch update is running) to sequentially upgrade `catalog`, `github-upstream`, and `github-url` plugins (always scheduling `agy-market` self-update last to trigger clean restart), and automatically hides when all plugins are up to date to keep the header uncluttered. ### 3. ⭐ Favorites Shelf & Tab, Installed Search/Filters & Update Error Alerts - **⭐ Pinned Favorites Shelf & Dedicated Favorites Tab**: - Every plugin card (Discover, Favorites, Installed) and the Detail Drawer header feature a tactile star button (`☆` / glowing amber `★`) backed by `POST /api/favorites` persisted atomically in `prefs.json`. - When 1 or more plugins are starred, a collapsible **Pinned Favorites Shelf (`★ Favorites`)** appears above the Discover grid, complemented by a dedicated **`★ Favorites`** top navigation tab (`Discover · Favorites · Installed · Conflicts & Diagnostics · Sources & Settings`). - **Live Search & Status Filters in `Installed` View**: - The **Installed** view includes a live search bar (matching display name, directory name, or description) and quick status filter pills (**All / Enabled / Disabled / Updatable**) for fast management at scale. - **High-Visibility Update Error Alert Banner (Zero Silent Failures)**: - Whenever an install/update, batch **Update All**, or self-update fails due to network errors, SHA-256 mismatch, or permissions, a dismissible red error banner and error toast surface the affected plugin, exact failure reason, and a one-click **Retry** button. ### 4. Native Card-Footer Enable / Disable Slider (Vault Parking) - **Zero Writes to `config.json`**: Antigravity's Language Server write-protects `~/.gemini/config/config.json`. AGY Market reads `config.json` strictly read-only and powers live toggling via **Vault Parking** (`POST /api/toggle-plugin`): - **Toggle OFF (Disable)**: Moves `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` cleanly into `${PLUGIN_DATA}/disabled-plugins/`. Host hot-watch unloads its Skills / Rules / Hooks within ~1 second. - **Toggle ON (Enable)**: Moves the folder back into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` and removes any stale `"disabled": true` flag. - **Update While Parked**: Disabled plugins remain visible in *Installed* and *Discover* tabs and update in-place inside `disabled-plugins/` without accidentally reactivating them. - **Safe Locking**: `agy-market` itself stays locked ON to prevent disconnecting its own panel; `workspace`, `builtin`, and host-disabled plugins show clear read-only lock states. ### 5. Local Plugin Conflict Checks & Fixes Dedicated **Conflicts & Diagnostics** tab (`GET /api/conflicts`) with read-only static conflict checks and one-click fixes (`POST /api/fix-conflict`): | Check | Severity | What It Detects | Quick Action | | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | | `duplicate-plugin-name` | Critical | Duplicate `plugin.json.name` across `workspace > global > builtin` precedence, pinpointing the winner and silently dropped victim directories | 1-click `--` scoped isolation rename | | `windows-symlink-ignored` | Critical | Symlinks or NTFS junctions inside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` that Windows `GetAllPlugins` silently skips | 1-click materialize to real directory | | `mcp-collision` | Critical / Warning | Duplicate `_` keys, collisions with global `mcp_config.json`, or bare generic server names (`search`, `db`, `fetch`, etc.) | Pinpoints colliding keys & sources | | `skill-shadowing` / `agent-shadowing` | Warning | Overlapping `skills/*/SKILL.md` or `agents/*.md` across active plugins, `~/.gemini/config/skills/*`, and built-in reserved names | Shows full override chain | | `host-enhancement-overlap` | Warning / Info | Two or more active plugins modifying `app.asar` (**Warning**, patch overlap risk) or using `cdp` UI enhancements (**Info**, generally compatible) | Advisory to review or disable duplicate | ### 6. Action-Triggered Restart & Reload Prompts Cards and the Detail Drawer stay clutter-free without static restart chips. Activation prompts appear **only after an install, update, batch update, or uninstall completes** (or when a Windows disable/uninstall retires a locked binary): - **Declarative Skills / Global Rules (`instant`)**: Hot-reloads immediately with no restart required. - **Sidebar Panel / MCP / Hooks (`reload-pane`)**: Prompts to reopen the Sidebar panel or refresh MCP after update/install completes. - **`app.asar` / First-Time `cdp` / Retired Locked Binaries (`host-restart`)**: Displays a clear banner reminding you to restart Antigravity for changes to take full effect. For `app.asar` patch plugins, both the banner and Detail Drawer clearly instruct you to run the plugin's bundled patch script (e.g., `node setup.cjs` per plugin docs) before restarting and re-run it after every AGY Market update, with one-click **Copy Plugin Folder** and **Patch Docs** helpers. ### 7. Built-In GitHub Discussions Integration - Every plugin Detail Drawer includes a **Discussions** tab (`GET /api/discussions`) that detects whether Discussions are enabled on the repository without needing a token and provides direct links to browse or start a thread. - Optionally configuring a personal GitHub Token in Settings (stored locally in `prefs.json` with `0600` permissions; never logged or persisted in caches) loads the latest 10 repository discussions directly inside the Sidebar panel. ### 8. Dual-Mirror China Acceleration & SHA-256 Verified Installs - **Three-Tier Live Catalog Resolution (No Stale Bundled Snapshot)**: 1. **Custom Feeds**: User/team static `index.json` URLs configured in `prefs.json` take highest priority. 2. **Primary Channel (GitHub Pages + `gh-pages` Raw Fallback)**: Conditional `ETag` (`If-None-Match`) / `If-Modified-Since` requests achieve `<50ms` `304 Not Modified` cache hits. 3. **Automatic Mainland China Mirror Fallback**: If GitHub Pages times out (`> 3.5s`) or fails, streams the pure-JSON `@agy-market/catalog` transport package from `registry.npmmirror.com` or `mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/npm` in memory; falls back to disk cache when offline. - **Language-Agnostic & SHA-256 Verified**: npm is used **strictly** as a JSON mirror CDN for catalog metadata—listed plugins do **not** need to be npm or JavaScript projects. Optional GitHub Release mirror prefixes are supported safely because every tarball is streamed and verified against the catalog `sha256` digest before extraction (`INTEGRITY_SHA256_MISMATCH` aborts immediately on any mismatch). --- ## 🚀 One-Line Bootstrap Install > Requires **Node.js >= 22.0.0** (zero runtime npm dependencies), or use the zero-npm OS installers below. - **Node / `npx` (Cross-Platform, Recommended — runs directly from GitHub)**: ```bash npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market ``` - **Windows PowerShell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` - **macOS / Linux Shell (Zero npm, SHA-256 Verified + Catalog Fallback)**: ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/azwosile/agy-market/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Once installed in Antigravity: - Open the Sidebar Panel: click `[AGY Market](sidecar://agy-market/market_pane/)` in chat, or open **Sidebar (`+`) → `Plugins` → `AGY Market`**. - Manage on Native Customizations Page: `[AGY Market](customization://agy-market)` --- ## 🔗 Adding Plugins from Any GitHub URL Starting with v1.4.0, you can preflight and install any community plugin directly from a full GitHub URL without waiting for catalog indexing — including single-subdirectory layouts, Monorepos, and repositories without Release tags. ### Option 1: Sidebar Top Bar `Add URL` (`链接添加`) Button (Two-Step Preflight) 1. Open the AGY Market Sidebar panel and click **`Add URL`** (`链接添加`) in the top bar (or click **Add via GitHub URL** when a Discover search returns no matches). 2. Paste any full GitHub URL and click **Inspect**: - Repository homepage: `https://github.com//` (resolves latest Release → Git Tag → default branch commit automatically) - Branch or subdirectory: `https://github.com///tree//` - Manifest blob URL: `https://github.com///blob//[/]plugin.json` - Release / tag / archive URLs: `/releases/tag/`, `/releases/latest`, `/releases/download//.tar.gz`, `/archive/...tar.gz` 3. AGY Market downloads the archive into an external staging directory and runs local static checks before installing: - **Multi-layout detection**: Supports root `plugin.json`, `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`, automatic unique-subdirectory detection (e.g. `agy-capsule/plugin.json`), and interactive subpath selection for Monorepo repositories (`plugins/*`, `.agents/plugins/*`, etc.). - **Preflight & safety checks**: Displays version or short `commitSha`, SHA-256 digest, capability badges, and install mode (native directory vs. `--` scoped isolation). Repositories missing a valid `plugin.json` or failing traversal/symlink/rule-smuggling checks are rejected with clear diagnostics and zero leftover files. - **Installed tracking & updates**: Installed items display a `GitHub URL` source badge in *Installed*, work with the Vault-Parking toggle slider, and check for updates via Release Tag or branch commit SHA. ### Option 2: CLI `npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add ` ```bash # Inspect and interactively install any GitHub plugin repository (supports subpaths & branch commits) npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com// # Target a specific Monorepo subdirectory with -- scoped isolation and non-interactive confirmation npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com// --subpath plugins/ --isolate --yes # Optional flags: --replace, --dest , --mirror , --token , --json npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add https://github.com///tree/main/ --yes --json ``` --- ## 🏷️ Capability Badges & Update Escalation Confirmation Every plugin surfaces static capability badges beside the Install button before installation: | Badge ID | Default Label | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `declarative-only` | `🟢 Declarative Skill` | Pure `skills/` or `agents/` markdown; zero background processes or hooks | | `global-rules` | `🔵 Global Rules (~N tok)` | Includes `rules/*.md` active in prompt context while enabled, with token estimate | | `sidecar-ui` | `🟣 Sidebar Panel` | Provides a visual interactive panel in the right Sidebar | | `mcp-stdio` | `🟠 Local MCP Process` | Spawns a local stdio MCP server defined in `mcp_config.json` | | `mcp-remote` | `🌐 Remote MCP Service` | Connects to an external HTTPS MCP endpoint (domains listed transparently) | | `lifecycle-hooks` | `🔶 Lifecycle Hooks` | Registers session/tool lifecycle hooks via `hooks.json` | | `host-enhancement` | `💡 Host UI Enhancement` | Uses local CDP bridge or `app.asar` workbench enhancements (glass skins, companion widgets); fully permitted, gentle notice only | - **Capability-Escalation Confirmation**: Updating a plugin that adds newly introduced privilege badges or remote MCP domains pauses for explicit user approval before syncing and updating `.agy-market-receipt.json`. - **Dual-Track Discovery**: Track 1 verified plugins appear by default; opting into **Track 2 Experimental Topic Discovery** automatically enforces `--` double-hyphen isolation. --- ## 🛠️ CLI Commands & Local Development ### CLI (`bin/agy-market.mjs`) ```bash # Install or update AGY Market (optional --dest ) npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market install # Preflight and install a plugin from any GitHub URL (--subpath, --isolate, --replace, --yes, --dest, --mirror, --token, --json) npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market add # Lock-safe uninstall of an installed global plugin (alias: remove; supports --yes, --dest , --json) npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market uninstall --yes --json # List local installed plugins, config/data paths & market receipts (--json supported) npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market status npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market status --json # Run local installation checks (Node >= 22, real directory check, 10-field manifest purity, built UI) & sweep retired Windows binaries npx --yes github:azwosile/agy-market doctor ``` ### Build & Test From Source ```powershell # Build single-file offline-capable Sidebar UI (sidecars/market_pane/index.html) & static showcase npm run build # Copy real plugin bundle into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-market (never symlinks/junctions) npm run install:local # Verify local installation node ./bin/agy-market.mjs doctor # Pack deterministic release tarball (dist/agy-market.tar.gz + .sha256) npm run pack:release # Run unit & integration tests npm test ``` --- ## 🔒 Security & Host Redlines - **Never Writes `~/.gemini/config/config.json`**: Read-only inspection only; Vault Parking handles enable/disable cleanly. - **Never Creates Symlinks / NTFS Junctions**: Every install performs real directory/file copies and rejects archive traversal (`..`) and symlink/hardlink tar entries. - **Windows Lock-Safe Sync & Crash Recovery**: Stages outside `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` in `${PLUGIN_DATA}/staging/`, journals transitions via `pending-journal.json` (auto-recovered 8s after boot), renames locked binaries to `*.old.`, and sweeps them via `retired-binaries.json`. - **Loopback-Only Local Server & CSRF Guard**: Listens strictly on `127.0.0.1` (ephemeral port) and enforces a 256-bit random `X-Sidecar-Token` + `Origin` check on all `POST`/`DELETE` routes. --- ## 📚 Guides, Architecture & Contributing - **[📖 Plugin Submission Guide (`docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md`)](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog/blob/main/docs/SUBMISSION_GUIDE.md)** — Full Track-1 single-YAML & Track-2 auto-discovery submission tutorial - Read **[`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)** and **[`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)** before modifying any module in this repository. To submit plugins, visit **[`azwosile/agy-market-catalog`](https://github.com/azwosile/agy-market-catalog)**. ## 📄 License [MIT License](./LICENSE)
