# 会话管理 (`archive-manager`)

[English](README.en.md)

适用于 Google Antigravity 的会话管理插件（Sidecar + Skill），支持浏览、归档、恢复、预览和导出会话。

## 界面预览

**主面板与超长消息自动折叠（未归档视图 · 琥珀淡黄归档按钮）**

![主面板与自动折叠预览](docs/screenshots/preview-main.png)

**已归档视图、全文检索高亮与 Markdown 展开预览（绿色一键恢复）**

![已归档视图与全文检索预览](docs/screenshots/preview-archived.png)

## 核心功能

- **多视图分类浏览**：一键切换「已归档」「未归档」「收藏」「闲置」「全部」五大视图并实时统计数量。
- **全文检索与多维筛选**：支持同时检索标题、项目名、历史消息正文（FTS 摘要索引）、自定义标签与个人备注；支持按项目、标签筛选及按最近更新 / 步数 / 标题排序。
- **原地归档与恢复（含撤回）**。点击绿色「恢复」或琥珀淡黄「归档」按钮即可切换状态。支持多选批量归档、恢复，以及按闲置天数（3 / 7 / 14 / 30 天）批量归档。
- **免恢复预览对话**
  - 优先读取 `transcript_full.jsonl`，可用时结合 `transcript.jsonl`，必要时回退到 FTS 摘要。历史数据缺失时，预览可能只包含部分消息或摘要。
  - 支持独立滚动、单条超长消息（> 450px）自动折叠并附带渐隐遮罩与「展开全文 / 收起」；
  - 预览工具栏提供「展开全部 / 全部折叠」「⬆ 顶部」「⬇ 底部」及「排版 / 原文」切换，长会话阅读跳转更顺手。
- **原生信息维护与安全删除**：支持原地重命名、卡片快捷置顶（📌）与星标收藏（★）、自定义标签（`#tag`）与自动保存个人备注（独立持久化于 Sidecar 数据目录），删除运行中会话前自动拦截并弹出二次确认。
- **一键导出 Markdown**。将可读取的对话内容连同会话信息、标签和备注保存到 `~/Documents/Antigravity-Exports`，支持定位文件或打开导出目录。
- **左侧导航栏快捷入口（可选）**。启用 CDP 后，左侧栏显示「会话管理」入口与已归档数量。右侧面板插件菜单和对话技能也可打开面板。

## v2.2.0 更新

- 面板顶部可切换 **简体中文 / English**。首次打开时根据面板浏览器的语言选择，手动切换后由插件记住所选语言。
- 面板操作、确认与失败提示、Markdown 导出的固定字段随所选语言显示（左栏快捷入口同步按当前语言精简展示，消息时间戳按本地时区显示）。会话正文、标题、标签和备注保留原文。
- 通用适配主流 Antigravity 宿主主题与美化插件：主色、表面层次、字体与深色代码块/Toast 优先跟随宿主语义变量，并加固自定义浮岛布局下的左侧栏唤起稳定性。

## v2.1.1 更新

- 修复快速切换会话或筛选条件时，较晚返回的旧请求覆盖当前预览或列表的问题。
- 批量归档与恢复支持撤回已成功变更的会话。部分操作失败时，面板会显示处理结果。
- 批量归档闲置会话时，后端按当前会话状态重新判断资格，跳过已归档、已收藏、已置顶、正在运行或尚未达到闲置天数的会话。
- 无法确认会话已停止时，阻止永久删除。标签和备注采用原子保存，读取异常时保留原文件。
- Markdown 导出记录内容来源，并在适用时标注警告。每次导出生成独立文件。
- 仅在发现可用的调试页面后读取左栏归档计数。归档状态变更后刷新角标。

## 安装方法

### 方式一：使用安装脚本（推荐）

**Windows (PowerShell)：**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git
cd agy-archive-manager
.\scripts\install.ps1
```

**macOS / Linux：**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git
cd agy-archive-manager
chmod +x scripts/install.sh
./scripts/install.sh
```

### 方式二：手动安装

将本仓库中的以下核心文件复制到 Antigravity 插件目录 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/archive-manager/`（Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\archive-manager\`）：

- `plugin.json`
- `logo.svg`
- `README.md`
- `README.en.md`
- `docs/screenshots/`（文档预览图）
- `LICENSE`
- `skills/`
- `sidecars/`

安装完成后，在 Antigravity 的 **Customizations → Plugins** 中启用 **会话管理 (Session Manager)**，即可在右侧辅助面板或通过对话指令「打开会话管理面板」唤醒。

## 目录结构

```text
agy-archive-manager/
├── plugin.json                         # 插件清单与元信息
├── agy-market.json                     # AGY Market 市场伴随配置
├── logo.svg                            # 插件图标
├── README.md                           # 中文说明文档
├── README.en.md                        # 英文说明文档
├── LICENSE                             # MIT 开源协议
├── docs/
│   └── screenshots/                    # 界面预览截图
├── scripts/
│   ├── install.ps1                     # Windows 一键安装 / 更新脚本
│   └── install.sh                      # macOS / Linux 一键安装 / 更新脚本
├── skills/
│   └── archive-manager/
│       └── SKILL.md                    # 对话唤醒技能定义
├── sidecars/
│   └── archive_manager/
│       ├── sidecar.json                # Sidecar 进程与面板入口配置
│       ├── server.mjs                  # 本地 HTTP + ConversationService 后端
│       ├── server-locale.mjs           # 后端提示与 Markdown 导出文案
│       ├── sidebar_injector.mjs        # 左侧栏快捷入口注入器（可选 CDP）
│       └── index.html                  # 前端双栏管理面板
└── test/                               # 本地回归测试套件
```

## 运行要求

- **Google Antigravity**。设计目标为 Antigravity 2.35.0。面板和进程生命周期使用公开的 Sidecar 机制。参见 [Antigravity Sidecar 文档](https://antigravity.google/docs/sidecars/)。
- **会话数据**。归档等操作通过内部 `ConversationService` 提交，搜索和预览读取内部 SQLite 摘要索引和转录文件，其中 SQLite 以只读方式打开。Antigravity 更新可能改变这些接口和数据格式。
- **Node.js**。本插件的 Sidecar 启动命令是 `node`，要求 Antigravity 实际启动的 Node.js 默认启用 `node:sqlite`，例如 Node.js 22.13+（22.x LTS 分支）或 Node.js 24 LTS。详见 [Node.js SQLite 文档](https://nodejs.org/api/sqlite.html)。
- **左侧栏快捷入口（可选）**。入口和归档角标依赖 Antigravity 的界面结构和 Chrome DevTools Protocol（CDP），使用时以 `--remote-debugging-port=0` 启动 Antigravity。

## 本地回归测试

测试使用 Node.js 22.15+（22.x LTS 分支）或 Node.js 24 LTS。在仓库根目录运行以下命令。

```sh
node --test
```

测试仅使用模拟的 Antigravity 服务和临时会话数据。

## 开源协议

本项目基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。

# Session Manager (`archive-manager`)

[简体中文](README.md)

A session manager plugin (Sidecar + Skill) for Google Antigravity. Browse, archive, restore, preview, and export your conversations.

## Screenshots

**Main Workspace & Auto-Collapsed Long Replies (Active View · Amber Archive Buttons)**

![Main Workspace and Auto-Collapse Preview](docs/screenshots/preview-main.png)

**Archived View, Full-Text Search Highlighting & Expanded Markdown Preview (Green One-Click Restore)**

![Archived View and Search Highlight Preview](docs/screenshots/preview-archived.png)

## Key Features

- **5-Tab Categorized Views**: Switch seamlessly across **Archived**, **Active**, **Starred**, **Stale**, and **All** conversations with live counts.
- **Full-Text Search & Multi-Dimensional Filters**: Search across titles, project names, message bodies (via read-only FTS index), custom tags, and personal notes; filter by project or tag and sort by last updated, step count, or title.
- **Archive and Restore with Undo**. Use the green **Restore** and amber **Archive** buttons to change a conversation's state in place. Select multiple conversations or archive stale conversations after 3, 7, 14, or 30 days.
- **Preview Without Restoring**
  - Prefers `transcript_full.jsonl` and uses `transcript.jsonl` where applicable. If neither transcript provides usable content, the panel can fall back to FTS excerpts. A preview may contain only partial messages or summaries when history is missing.
  - Smooth independent scrolling, automatic collapsing with a fade overlay for long replies (> 450px) and an **Expand / Collapse** toggle, plus toolbar shortcuts for **Expand All / Collapse All**, **Top**, **Bottom**, and **Markdown / Raw** view.
- **Inline Organization & Safe Deletion**: Rename conversations inline, pin (📌) or star (★) directly from list cards, attach custom `#tags` and auto-saved personal notes (stored cleanly in Sidecar data dir), and safely block/confirm deletion of running conversations.
- **Markdown Export**. Save available conversation content, metadata, tags, and notes to `~/Documents/Antigravity-Exports`. Open the export folder or reveal the saved file from the panel.
- **Optional Left-Sidebar Quick Entry**. With CDP enabled, the left sidebar shows a **Session Manager** button and the archived count. The side-panel Plugins menu and skill prompts also open the panel.

## What's new in v2.2.0

- Use the **简体中文 / English** menu at the top of the panel to change languages. The browser language determines whether the panel opens in Chinese or English the first time. The plugin remembers your choice.
- The selected language applies to panel controls, confirmations, errors, concise left-sidebar labels, and labels in Markdown exports, while timestamps follow your local timezone. Conversation text, titles, tags, and notes stay in their original language.
- Universal host theme & UI pack compatibility: dynamic `color-mix` accent/surface tokens, inherited host fonts, dark/light-safe code blocks & toasts, and hardened left-sidebar tab matching across custom layouts.

## What's new in v2.1.1

- When conversations or filters change quickly, older responses no longer overwrite the current preview or list.
- Undo is available for successful changes in a batch. The panel reports partial failures.
- Before archiving stale conversations in bulk, the backend checks their current state and skips conversations that are archived, starred, pinned, running, or below the selected inactivity threshold.
- Permanent deletion requires an explicit idle state. Tags and notes are saved atomically, and unreadable metadata files are preserved.
- Markdown exports record the content source and include warnings where appropriate. Each export creates a separate file.
- The optional sidebar only reads the archive count after finding a usable debugging page. Archive changes refresh the badge.

## Installation

### Option 1: Install Scripts (Recommended)

**Windows (PowerShell):**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git
cd agy-archive-manager
.\scripts\install.ps1
```

**macOS / Linux:**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git
cd agy-archive-manager
chmod +x scripts/install.sh
./scripts/install.sh
```

### Option 2: Manual Installation

Copy the plugin payload into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/archive-manager/` (`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\archive-manager\` on Windows):

- `plugin.json`
- `logo.svg`
- `README.md`
- `README.en.md`
- `docs/screenshots/` (images used in the READMEs)
- `LICENSE`
- `skills/`
- `sidecars/`

Then enable **Session Manager (`archive-manager`)** in Antigravity under **Customizations → Plugins**.

## Requirements

- **Google Antigravity**. The plugin targets Antigravity 2.35.0 and uses publicly documented Sidecar support for the panel and process lifecycle. See the [Antigravity Sidecar documentation](https://antigravity.google/docs/sidecars/).
- **Conversation data**. The plugin uses Antigravity's internal `ConversationService` for session operations, a read-only SQLite summary index, and transcript files. Antigravity updates can change these interfaces and data formats.
- **Node.js**. The Sidecar command is `node`. The Node.js runtime that Antigravity launches must enable `node:sqlite` by default. Examples include Node.js 22.13+ on the 22.x LTS line and Node.js 24 LTS. See the [Node.js SQLite documentation](https://nodejs.org/api/sqlite.html).
- **Left-sidebar quick entry (optional)**. The quick-entry button and badge depend on Antigravity's UI and Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). Start Antigravity with `--remote-debugging-port=0` to use them.

## Local regression tests

The test harness requires Node.js 22.15+ on the 22.x LTS line or Node.js 24 LTS. Run from the repository root.

```sh
node --test
```

The tests use mock Antigravity services and temporary conversation data.

[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE.svg)](LICENSE)
[![platform: macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%2013%2B-000000.svg)](#环境要求)
[![hosts: Antigravity | DSH | Zed](https://img.shields.io/badge/hosts-Antigravity%20%7C%20DSH%20%7C%20Zed-4D6BFE.svg)](#分层架构)

**macOS 通用悬浮回答卡片：当 Antigravity、DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 或 Zed 中的 Agent 需要你批准、回答或收尾时，直接把决定搬到屏幕置顶悬浮窗——按一键或点一下即完成响应，无需切换窗口。**

A host-agnostic macOS always-on-top floating card for AI coding agents (**Antigravity**, **DeepSeek Harness**, and **Zed**). Approve tool calls, answer single/multi-select or free-text questions, and jump back or send follow-ups without breaking focus.

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Antigravity · 需要你回答                 [ 展开 E ] │
│ answer-card · 确认插件架构                         │
│                                                   │
│ ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ 1  直接代我作答    点了就等于已回答            │ │
│ ├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │
│ │ 2  只切回前台      交回宿主原生界面            │ │
│ └───────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┬─┐ │
│ │ 也可以直接输入补充说明（回车换行，⌘⏎ 提交）… │3│ │
│ └─────────────────────────────────────────────┴─┘ │
│ [ 稍后处理 ]                         [ 提交答案 ]  │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 核心功能

- **审批代答**：工具请求权限时后台弹卡，支持「允许一次 / 本次会话允许 / 总是允许 / 拒绝」以及直接输入拒绝原因或替代指令；Antigravity 自动附带 `permissionOverrides` 避免原生二次弹窗，点「稍后处理」无损交回宿主原生界面。
- **提问与多题作答**：支持单选、多选、自由文本以及选项 + 补充说明；单选聚焦输入框自动取消已选项，多题支持部分作答提交。
- **完成提醒 & 直接追问**：回合结束后后台弹卡；留空确认一键激活宿主并按标题关键词拉起对应窗口（支持多窗口）；Antigravity 与 DSH 支持在完成卡里直接输入追问续跑下一轮（Antigravity 走 `decision: continue`，DSH 走 `agent.followup()`，都不需要切回界面）。
- **动态主题自适应**：自动跟随当前 Agent 实时浅/深配色——Antigravity 通过 MCP App `hostContext` 同步、DSH 同步实时样式、Zed 自动读取 `settings.json` 与已安装扩展主题（兼容 Blur 透明主题）。
- **跨宿主统一可视化设置页**：三端共享同一套 `<answer-card-settings>` Web Component（Antigravity 内置侧边栏/全页 MCP App、DSH 插件设置分区、Zed 本地设置页），所有配置统一存入 `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json`（共享层 + 按宿主覆写层）。
- **完整键盘操作 & Markdown 渲染**：支持数字键选择/取消/聚焦、`⌘` 组合键在输入态触发、常驻 `展开 E` / `收起 E` 且展开自动防溢出屏幕、正文 Markdown（含行内代码/可点击链接）划选与 `⌘C` 复制。
- **智能防打扰 & 失败开放**：宿主位于前台时静默回退原生 UI；支持工作区（精确或末尾 `/` 前缀）与会话级静音、完成提醒冷却；任何编译/执行异常或超时均失败开放，绝不卡死 Agent。

## 键盘快捷键

非输入态直接按单键即可；仅在光标位于输入框内时加 `⌘` 前缀触发同类操作：

| 功能 | 非输入态 | 输入框内 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 选中/取消选项，或聚焦输入框 | `1`–`9`（含小键盘） | `⌘1`–`⌘9` |
| 展开 / 收起卡片（自动防溢出屏幕） | `E` | `⌘E`（保留输入内容与焦点） |
| 提交 / 发送追问 | `Return` | `⌘Return`（`Return` 换行） |
| 退出输入框 / 关闭（稍后处理） | `Esc`（关闭卡片） | `Esc`（先退出输入焦点） |
| 复制 / 粘贴 / 剪切 / 全选 / 撤销 | `⌘C`（复制选中正文） | `⌘C` / `⌘V` / `⌘X` / `⌘A` / `⌘Z` |

## 分层架构

```text
answer-card/
├── plugin.json / hooks.json / mcp_config.json    # Antigravity 原生插件入口（根目录即可安装）
├── rules/ / skills/ / assets/                    # Antigravity 规则与设置 Skill
├── package.json / cordis.patch.yml               # DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle 入口
├── core/                                         # 共享核心（运行期零第三方依赖，多宿主共用）
│   ├── swift/PromptWindow.swift                  # macOS AppKit 悬浮窗、--probe、--activate
│   ├── helper.mjs                                # swiftc 编译缓存、前台探测、跨进程互斥锁
│   ├── settings.mjs                              # 统一配置（全局 + hosts.<id> 覆写）、静音、冷却
│   ├── theme.mjs                                 # 跨宿主动态主题解析（快照 / Zed 扩展 / 系统外观）
│   ├── protocol.mjs                              # 审批 / 提问 / 完成 / 测试卡片载荷构造
│   ├── bridge.mjs                                # 远程 SSH 反向转发桥接（服务端自动启动 + 客户端）
│   ├── settings-server.mjs                       # 本地 127.0.0.1 可视化设置页服务（Zed / CLI 复用）
│   ├── mcp.mjs                                   # 通用 stdio MCP Server（Zed / 跨宿主复用）
│   └── cli.mjs                                   # 通用设置、静音、测试与本地设置页 CLI
└── adapters/
    ├── shared/ui/                                # 跨宿主共享 <answer-card-settings> Web Component
    ├── antigravity/                              # Antigravity PreToolUse / Stop Hook + MCP App
    ├── dsh/                                      # DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件 + Web 设置挂载
    └── zed/                                      # Zed MCP 启动器 + 可选 ACP 权限代理
```

## 环境要求

- **macOS 13+**（原生 AppKit 悬浮窗）
- **Node.js ≥ 20**（运行期零第三方依赖，UI 产物已预构建，安装后无需 `npm install`）
- **Xcode Command Line Tools**（提供 `swiftc`；若未安装请执行 `xcode-select --install`）

> 首次触发时会将 `core/swift/PromptWindow.swift` 编译缓存到 `~/Library/Caches/answer-card/PromptWindow-<hash>`（约 1–3 秒），后续毫秒级复用。

## 安装与配置

### 1. Antigravity

#### 方式一：直接克隆到 Antigravity 插件目录（推荐，App / IDE / CLI 通用）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card
```

可选：预先编译一次 Swift 悬浮窗助手：

```bash
node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card/core/cli.mjs compile
```

#### 方式二：通过 `agy` CLI 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card.git
agy plugin install ./answer-card
```

安装启用后即可在 **左侧边栏 → Answer Card**、**右侧辅助栏 `+` → Answer Card** 或对话中说「打开 Answer Card 设置」打开内置可视化面板。

| 场景 | Hook / 机制 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 模型提问（`ask_question`） | `PreToolUse` + `rules/AGENTS.md` | 后台弹提问卡，答完直接回传给模型继续；前台 / 稍后处理 / 超时回退原生弹窗 |
| 工具审批（`run_command` / `call_mcp_tool` / `write_file` / `edit_file`） | `PreToolUse` | 按 `approvalPolicy` 后台弹审批卡，支持一次/会话/总是允许与拒绝原因输入 |
| 回合完成 | `Stop` | 后台弹完成卡；留空确认切回对应窗口，输入文字直接返回 `decision: "continue"` 续跑 |

> **审批拦截策略（`approvalPolicy`）**：`external`（默认，拦截越沙箱/高风险命令、工作区外文件写操作与 MCP）、`commands`（全部命令与 MCP）、`mutating`（命令、文件写/改与 MCP）、`all`（全部匹配工具）。
>
> **关于 Antigravity 原生权限门与 Turbo 模式**：Antigravity 的原生权限门位于 `PreToolUse` Hook 之前。将 **Settings → General → Global Permissions** 切为 **Turbo** 后，越沙箱命令行（`BypassSandbox: true`）会放行进入 `PreToolUse` 由 Answer Card 接管；但对工作区外敏感路径（如 `~/.ssh/config`、`~/.gemini/config/config.json`）Antigravity 仍保留独立的文件边界保护（需单独放开 **Non-Workspace File Access**，且部分硬编码敏感目录始终走原生确认）。若日后停用 `answer-card` 插件，请及时改回默认预设。

---

### 2. DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

仓库完整保留 DSH bundle 入口（`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` + 共享设置组件）：

- **桌面端**：设置 → 插件 → 安装，填入 `https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card`
- **命令行**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/answer-card`

首次启动会自动将旧的 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-answer-card.json` 迁移到 `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json` 的 `hosts.dsh` 中（兼容 `skipWhenDSHFocused`），并在 DSH 设置页挂载同一套 `<answer-card-settings>` 面板。

---

### 3. Zed

Zed 通过共享 `core/` 提供原生 MCP Server（以及可选的 ACP Proxy），详见 [adapters/zed/README.md](adapters/zed/README.md)。

在 `~/.config/zed/settings.json` 中加入：

```json
{
  "context_servers": {
    "answer-card": {
      "command": "/path/to/answer-card/adapters/zed/mcp.sh",
      "args": []
    }
  },
  "agent": {
    "tool_permissions": {
      "tools": {
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_ask": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_approve": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_notify": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_open_settings": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_settings": { "default": "allow" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

提供的 5 个 MCP 工具：
- `answer_card_ask`：弹出悬浮提问卡并返回答案。
- `answer_card_approve`：弹出悬浮审批卡（支持填写拒绝原因 / 替代指令）。
- `answer_card_notify`：弹出完成卡，一键切回并拉起对应 Zed 窗口。
- `answer_card_open_settings`：启动仅监听 `127.0.0.1` 的本地可视化设置页（复用 `<answer-card-settings>`，自动套用 Zed 当前主题）并在浏览器打开。
- `answer_card_settings`：在 Zed 对话中直接读取 / 修改配置或发送测试卡片。

> 若需要拦截外部 ACP Agent 的原生权限请求，还可在 `agent_servers` 中用 `adapters/zed/acp-proxy.sh -- <acp-agent>` 包装（详见 [adapters/zed/README.md](adapters/zed/README.md)）。

---

### 4. 远程 SSH 会话支持（Linux 服务器 → 本机 Mac 弹窗）

本机 macOS 启用 Antigravity / Zed 插件时会自动监听 `127.0.0.1:19876`（带随机 Bearer Token，强制使用本机 Mac 外观/主题与 `returnCommand`，绝不执行远端传入命令）。让远程 SSH 主机也支持本机弹卡只需两步：

1. **在 `~/.ssh/config` 给目标主机加一行反向转发**：

```sshconfig
Host your-remote-host
  RemoteForward 19876 127.0.0.1:19876
```

2. **在本机一键部署插件并同步 Token 到远端**：

```bash
node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card/core/cli.mjs ssh-install your-remote-host
```

之后重连 SSH 即可生效：远端 Linux 上的 `PreToolUse` / `Stop` Hook 会自动检测 `~/.config/answer-card/bridge-token`，把审批、提问与完成卡通过隧道转发到你的 Mac 弹出（无隧道时毫秒级失败开放，回退原生界面）。

## 统一配置与 CLI

所有宿主共用 `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json`（共享全局外观 + `hosts.<id>` 按宿主独立覆写）：

```bash
# 打开本地可视化设置页（默认聚焦指定宿主）
node core/cli.mjs ui --host zed

# 查看当前生效配置
node core/cli.mjs status --host antigravity

# 发送测试卡片 / 测试「回到宿主」
node core/cli.mjs test --host zed
node core/cli.mjs test-return --host zed

# 修改全局（--global）或单宿主（--host）配置
node core/cli.mjs set position cursor --global
node core/cli.mjs set width 500 --global
node core/cli.mjs set fontScale 1.1 --global
node core/cli.mjs set approvalPolicy commands --host antigravity

# 静音工作区（末尾带 / 匹配整个子目录）或会话
node core/cli.mjs mute-workspace /path/to/workspace/ --host antigravity
node core/cli.mjs mute-session <sessionId> --host antigravity

# 开启诊断日志
node core/cli.mjs set traceFile /tmp/answer-card.log --global
```

## 开发与测试

```bash
npm run build:ui   # 修改 adapters/shared/ui 或宿主设置入口后重新构建前端产物（需先 npm install）
npm run check      # 全量 JS 语法检查
npm test           # 运行核心与三宿主适配器单测
npm run compile    # 预编译 macOS Swift 悬浮窗助手
```

## 环境要求

- **macOS 13+**（原生 AppKit 悬浮窗）
- **Node.js ≥ 20**（运行期零第三方依赖，UI 产物已预构建，安装后无需 `npm install`）
- **Xcode Command Line Tools**（提供 `swiftc`；若未安装请执行 `xcode-select --install`）

> 首次触发时会将 `core/swift/PromptWindow.swift` 编译缓存到 `~/Library/Caches/answer-card/PromptWindow-<hash>`（约 1–3 秒），后续毫秒级复用。

## 安装与配置

### 1. Antigravity

#### 方式一：直接克隆到 Antigravity 插件目录（推荐，App / IDE / CLI 通用）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card
```

可选：预先编译一次 Swift 悬浮窗助手：

```bash
node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card/core/cli.mjs compile
```

#### 方式二：通过 `agy` CLI 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card.git
agy plugin install ./answer-card
```

安装启用后即可在 **左侧边栏 → Answer Card**、**右侧辅助栏 `+` → Answer Card** 或对话中说「打开 Answer Card 设置」打开内置可视化面板。

| 场景 | Hook / 机制 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 模型提问（`ask_question`） | `PreToolUse` + `rules/AGENTS.md` | 后台弹提问卡，答完直接回传给模型继续；前台 / 稍后处理 / 超时回退原生弹窗 |
| 工具审批（`run_command` / `call_mcp_tool` / `write_file` / `edit_file`） | `PreToolUse` | 按 `approvalPolicy` 后台弹审批卡，支持一次/会话/总是允许与拒绝原因输入 |
| 回合完成 | `Stop` | 后台弹完成卡；留空确认切回对应窗口，输入文字直接返回 `decision: "continue"` 续跑 |

> **审批拦截策略（`approvalPolicy`）**：`external`（默认，拦截越沙箱/高风险命令、工作区外文件写操作与 MCP）、`commands`（全部命令与 MCP）、`mutating`（命令、文件写/改与 MCP）、`all`（全部匹配工具）。
>
> **关于 Antigravity 原生权限门与 Turbo 模式**：Antigravity 的原生权限门位于 `PreToolUse` Hook 之前。将 **Settings → General → Global Permissions** 切为 **Turbo** 后，越沙箱命令行（`BypassSandbox: true`）会放行进入 `PreToolUse` 由 Answer Card 接管；但对工作区外敏感路径（如 `~/.ssh/config`、`~/.gemini/config/config.json`）Antigravity 仍保留独立的文件边界保护（需单独放开 **Non-Workspace File Access**，且部分硬编码敏感目录始终走原生确认）。若日后停用 `answer-card` 插件，请及时改回默认预设。

---

### 2. DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

仓库完整保留 DSH bundle 入口（`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` + 共享设置组件）：

- **桌面端**：设置 → 插件 → 安装，填入 `https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card`
- **命令行**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/answer-card`

首次启动会自动将旧的 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-answer-card.json` 迁移到 `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json` 的 `hosts.dsh` 中（兼容 `skipWhenDSHFocused`），并在 DSH 设置页挂载同一套 `<answer-card-settings>` 面板。

---

### 3. Zed

Zed 通过共享 `core/` 提供原生 MCP Server（以及可选的 ACP Proxy），详见 [adapters/zed/README.md](adapters/zed/README.md)。

在 `~/.config/zed/settings.json` 中加入：

```json
{
  "context_servers": {
    "answer-card": {
      "command": "/path/to/answer-card/adapters/zed/mcp.sh",
      "args": []
    }
  },
  "agent": {
    "tool_permissions": {
      "tools": {
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_ask": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_approve": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_notify": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_open_settings": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_settings": { "default": "allow" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

提供的 5 个 MCP 工具：
- `answer_card_ask`：弹出悬浮提问卡并返回答案。
- `answer_card_approve`：弹出悬浮审批卡（支持填写拒绝原因 / 替代指令）。
- `answer_card_notify`：弹出完成卡，一键切回并拉起对应 Zed 窗口。
- `answer_card_open_settings`：启动仅监听 `127.0.0.1` 的本地可视化设置页（复用 `<answer-card-settings>`，自动套用 Zed 当前主题）并在浏览器打开。
- `answer_card_settings`：在 Zed 对话中直接读取 / 修改配置或发送测试卡片。

> 若需要拦截外部 ACP Agent 的原生权限请求，还可在 `agent_servers` 中用 `adapters/zed/acp-proxy.sh -- <acp-agent>` 包装（详见 [adapters/zed/README.md](adapters/zed/README.md)）。

---

### 4. 远程 SSH 会话支持（Linux 服务器 → 本机 Mac 弹窗）

本机 macOS 启用 Antigravity / Zed 插件时会自动监听 `127.0.0.1:19876`（带随机 Bearer Token，强制使用本机 Mac 外观/主题与 `returnCommand`，绝不执行远端传入命令）。让远程 SSH 主机也支持本机弹卡只需两步：

1. **在 `~/.ssh/config` 给目标主机加一行反向转发**：

```sshconfig
Host your-remote-host
  RemoteForward 19876 127.0.0.1:19876
```

2. **在本机一键部署插件并同步 Token 到远端**：

```bash
node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card/core/cli.mjs ssh-install your-remote-host
```

之后重连 SSH 即可生效：远端 Linux 上的 `PreToolUse` / `Stop` Hook 会自动检测 `~/.config/answer-card/bridge-token`，把审批、提问与完成卡通过隧道转发到你的 Mac 弹出（无隧道时毫秒级失败开放，回退原生界面）。

## 统一配置与 CLI

所有宿主共用 `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json`（共享全局外观 + `hosts.<id>` 按宿主独立覆写）：

```bash
# 打开本地可视化设置页（默认聚焦指定宿主）
node core/cli.mjs ui --host zed

# 查看当前生效配置
node core/cli.mjs status --host antigravity

# 发送测试卡片 / 测试「回到宿主」
node core/cli.mjs test --host zed
node core/cli.mjs test-return --host zed

# 修改全局（--global）或单宿主（--host）配置
node core/cli.mjs set position cursor --global
node core/cli.mjs set width 500 --global
node core/cli.mjs set fontScale 1.1 --global
node core/cli.mjs set approvalPolicy commands --host antigravity

# 静音工作区（末尾带 / 匹配整个子目录）或会话
node core/cli.mjs mute-workspace /path/to/workspace/ --host antigravity
node core/cli.mjs mute-session <sessionId> --host antigravity

# 开启诊断日志
node core/cli.mjs set traceFile /tmp/answer-card.log --global
```

# answer-card

[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE.svg)](LICENSE)
[![platform: macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%2013%2B-000000.svg)](#requirements)
[![hosts: Antigravity | DSH | Zed](https://img.shields.io/badge/hosts-Antigravity%20%7C%20DSH%20%7C%20Zed-4D6BFE.svg)](#architecture)

**A host-agnostic macOS floating answer card: when an agent in Antigravity, DeepSeek Harness (DSH) or Zed needs your approval, an answer, or a wrap-up, the decision moves into an always-on-top window — one keystroke or one click, no window switching.**

Approve tool calls, answer single/multi-select or free-text questions, and jump back or send a follow-up without breaking focus.

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Antigravity · Needs your answer            [ Expand E ] │
│ answer-card · Confirm plugin architecture         │
│                                                   │
│ ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ 1  Answer for me     Clicking equals answering │ │
│ ├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │
│ │ 2  Just switch back  Hand over to host's native UI │ │
│ └───────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┬─┐ │
│ │ Optional note (Return = newline, ⌘⏎ = submit)… │3│ │
│ └─────────────────────────────────────────────┴─┘ │
│ [ Later ]                            [ Submit answer ] │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Core Features

- **Approval on the card**: when a tool asks for permission the card pops up in the background with *Allow once / Allow for session / Always allow / Deny*, plus a free-text denial reason or replacement instruction. Antigravity automatically receives `permissionOverrides` so the native dialog does not appear twice; picking *Later* hands control back to the host UI with no loss.
- **Questions and multi-question forms**: single choice, multi choice, free text, and option + note combinations. Focusing the input clears a single-choice selection; partially answered multi-question forms can still be submitted.
- **Completion notice and inline follow-up**: a card pops up when a turn ends. Confirming with a blank input activates the host and raises the matching window by title keyword (multi-window aware); Antigravity and DSH also accept a follow-up typed straight into the completion card (Antigravity via `decision: continue`, DSH via `agent.followup()`), so the next turn runs without switching back.
- **Live theme adaptation**: follows the current agent's light/dark palette in real time — Antigravity through the MCP App `hostContext`, DSH through live style sync, Zed by reading `settings.json` and installed extension themes (Blur transparency included).
- **One visual settings panel across hosts**: a single `<answer-card-settings>` Web Component shared by all three hosts (Antigravity sidebar/full-page MCP App, DSH plugin settings section, Zed local settings page). All settings live in `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json` (shared layer plus per-host overrides).
- **Full keyboard control and Markdown rendering**: number keys select/clear/focus, `⌘`-combinations apply while typing, an always-present `Expand E` / `Collapse E` that never overflows the screen, and Markdown bodies (inline code, clickable links) that can be selected and copied with `⌘C`.
- **Non-intrusive and fail-open**: silently falls back to the native UI when the host is frontmost; supports per-workspace (exact path, or a trailing `/` prefix) and per-session muting plus a completion cooldown; any compile/exec error or timeout fails open and never blocks the agent.

## Keyboard Shortcuts

Outside the input box, a bare key is enough; while the cursor is inside the input box, prefix the same action with `⌘`:

| Action | Outside input | Inside input |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Select/clear an option, or focus the input | `1`–`9` (keypad included) | `⌘1`–`⌘9` |
| Expand / collapse the card (never overflows) | `E` | `⌘E` (keeps text and focus) |
| Submit / send follow-up | `Return` | `⌘Return` (`Return` inserts a newline) |
| Leave the input / dismiss (later) | `Esc` (closes the card) | `Esc` (leaves input focus first) |
| Copy / paste / cut / select all / undo | `⌘C` (copy selected body text) | `⌘C` / `⌘V` / `⌘X` / `⌘A` / `⌘Z` |

```text
answer-card/
├── plugin.json / hooks.json / mcp_config.json    # Antigravity native entry (installable from repo root)
├── rules/ / skills/ / assets/                    # Antigravity rules and the settings skill
├── package.json / cordis.patch.yml               # DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle entry
├── core/                                         # Shared core (zero runtime third-party deps, used by every host)
│   ├── swift/PromptWindow.swift                  # macOS AppKit floating window, --probe, --activate
│   ├── helper.mjs                                # swiftc build cache, foreground probe, cross-process mutex
│   ├── settings.mjs                              # unified config (global + hosts.<id> override), mute, cooldown
│   ├── theme.mjs                                 # cross-host theme resolution (snapshot / Zed extension / system appearance)
│   ├── protocol.mjs                              # approval / question / completion / test card payloads
│   ├── bridge.mjs                                # remote SSH reverse-forward bridge (auto server + client)
│   ├── settings-server.mjs                       # local 127.0.0.1 visual settings page (Zed / CLI reuse)
│   ├── mcp.mjs                                   # generic stdio MCP server (Zed / cross-host reuse)
```

## Requirements

- **macOS 13+** (native AppKit floating window)
- **Node.js ≥ 20** (zero third-party runtime dependencies; UI artifacts are prebuilt, so no `npm install` after installation)
- **Xcode Command Line Tools** (provides `swiftc`; run `xcode-select --install` if missing)

> On first trigger `core/swift/PromptWindow.swift` is compiled and cached to `~/Library/Caches/answer-card/PromptWindow-<hash>` (about 1–3 seconds); later runs reuse it in milliseconds.

## Installation and Configuration

### 1. Antigravity

#### Option A: clone into the Antigravity plugin directory (recommended; works for App / IDE / CLI)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card
```

Optional: precompile the Swift helper once:

```bash
node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card/core/cli.mjs compile
```

#### Option B: install through the `agy` CLI

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card.git
agy plugin install ./answer-card
```

Once enabled, open the built-in visual panel from **left sidebar → Answer Card**, **right side pane `+` → Answer Card**, or by asking "open Answer Card settings" in the conversation.

| Scenario | Hook / mechanism | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Model asks a question (`ask_question`) | `PreToolUse` + `rules/AGENTS.md` | Question card pops up in the background; the answer is returned to the model directly, which continues; frontmost / later / timeout falls back to the native dialog |
| Tool approval (`run_command` / `call_mcp_tool` / `write_file` / `edit_file`) | `PreToolUse` | Approval card driven by `approvalPolicy`, with once/session/always allow and a denial-reason input |
| Turn completion | `Stop` | Completion card pops up; blank confirm switches back to the matching window, typed text returns `decision: "continue"` to run another turn |

> **Approval interception policy (`approvalPolicy`)**: `external` (default — intercepts out-of-sandbox/high-risk commands, writes outside the workspace, and MCP), `commands` (all commands and MCP), `mutating` (commands, file writes/edits and MCP), `all` (every matched tool).
>
> **On Antigravity's native permission gate and Turbo mode**: Antigravity's native permission gate runs *before* the `PreToolUse` hook. Switching **Settings → General → Global Permissions** to **Turbo** lets out-of-sandbox commands (`BypassSandbox: true`) through to `PreToolUse`, where Answer Card takes over. Sensitive paths outside the workspace (such as `~/.ssh/config`, `~/.gemini/config/config.json`) remain behind Antigravity's separate file boundary (you must enable **Non-Workspace File Access**, and some hard-coded sensitive directories always use the native confirmation). If you disable the `answer-card` plugin later, remember to restore the default preset.

---

### 2. DeepSeek Harness (DSH)

The repository keeps its DSH bundle entry intact (`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml` + the shared settings component):

- **Desktop**: Settings → Plugins → Install, and enter `https://github.com/Asthestarsfalll/answer-card`
- **CLI**: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/answer-card`

On first start the legacy `$DSH_HOME/dsh-answer-card.json` is migrated into `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json` under `hosts.dsh` (`skipWhenDSHFocused` is preserved), and the same `<answer-card-settings>` panel is mounted in the DSH settings page.

---

### 3. Zed

Zed gets a native MCP server from the shared `core/` (plus an optional ACP proxy); see [adapters/zed/README.md](adapters/zed/README.md).

Add this to `~/.config/zed/settings.json`:

```json
{
  "context_servers": {
    "answer-card": {
      "command": "/path/to/answer-card/adapters/zed/mcp.sh",
      "args": []
    }
  },
  "agent": {
    "tool_permissions": {
      "tools": {
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_ask": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_approve": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_notify": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_open_settings": { "default": "allow" },
        "mcp:answer-card:answer_card_settings": { "default": "allow" }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

The five MCP tools:
- `answer_card_ask`: show a floating question card and return the answer.
- `answer_card_approve`: show a floating approval card (denial reason / replacement instruction supported).
- `answer_card_notify`: show a completion card that switches back and raises the matching Zed window.
- `answer_card_open_settings`: start a local visual settings page bound to `127.0.0.1` (reuses `<answer-card-settings>`, applies Zed's current theme) and open it in the browser.
- `answer_card_settings`: read or change configuration, or send test cards, directly from a Zed conversation.

> To intercept native permission requests from an external ACP agent, wrap it with `adapters/zed/acp-proxy.sh -- <acp-agent>` in `agent_servers` (see [adapters/zed/README.md](adapters/zed/README.md)).

---

### 4. Remote SSH sessions (Linux server → card on your Mac)

With the Antigravity / Zed plugin enabled, macOS listens on `127.0.0.1:19876` (random bearer token; always uses the local Mac appearance/theme and `returnCommand`, and never executes commands passed from the remote side). Two steps make a remote SSH host use the local card:

1. **Add a reverse forward for the host in `~/.ssh/config`**:

```sshconfig
Host your-remote-host
  RemoteForward 19876 127.0.0.1:19876
```

2. **Deploy the plugin to the remote and sync the token from your Mac**:

```bash
node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/answer-card/core/cli.mjs ssh-install your-remote-host
```

Reconnecting over SSH is enough: the remote `PreToolUse` / `Stop` hooks detect `~/.config/answer-card/bridge-token` and forward approvals, questions and completion cards through the tunnel to your Mac (with no tunnel they fail open in milliseconds and fall back to the native UI).

## Shared Configuration and CLI

Every host shares `~/.config/answer-card/settings.json` (shared global appearance plus per-host overrides under `hosts.<id>`):

```bash
# Open the local visual settings page (focused on the given host)
node core/cli.mjs ui --host zed

# Show the effective configuration
node core/cli.mjs status --host antigravity

# Send a test card / test "return to host"
node core/cli.mjs test --host zed
node core/cli.mjs test-return --host zed

# Change a global (--global) or per-host (--host) setting
node core/cli.mjs set position cursor --global
node core/cli.mjs set width 500 --global
node core/cli.mjs set fontScale 1.1 --global
node core/cli.mjs set approvalPolicy commands --host antigravity

# Mute a workspace (a trailing / matches the whole subtree) or a session
node core/cli.mjs mute-workspace /path/to/workspace/ --host antigravity
node core/cli.mjs mute-session <sessionId> --host antigravity

# Enable the diagnostic trace log
node core/cli.mjs set traceFile /tmp/answer-card.log --global
```
